programme.desc: 台湾广受欢迎的常青美食料理节目，由2006年始播至今，2011年还获选金钟奖的最佳综合节目主持人奖。每一期将有不同的主题：“大明星來下廚”由兩位明星或两个明星档分組對抗，拿出自己的拿手菜對抗比拼；“五分钟出好菜”由两位厨师根据指定食材，在五分钟内烹煮出易学美味的一道菜等。这是一个富有娱乐效果的轻松美食节目，能够持续制作这么多年不是没有理由的。

programme.title: 舌尖上的绍兴 / Eating in Shaoxing Episode 4
programme.desc: 《舌尖上的绍兴》是一部深度挖掘绍兴地区美食人文的纪录片。每一集讲述绍兴一个地域独特的地方口味和生活特色，分别围绕绍兴越城、柯桥、诸暨、嵊州、新昌、上虞六个区域的不同地域文化背景和美食特色，挖掘当地特有的饮食文化，探寻绍兴人不同的饮食结构与生活方式。以美食+文旅为出发点，凸显地方烟火气，地域自然风貌、人文传承和美食之间的关系，充分展示其地方饮食口味，看到绍兴充满文化气质的生活方式，更能看到城市的历史、文化和环境的印记。 这部纪录片节奏紧凑，画面风格清新且贴近生活。通过真实质朴的纪录手法，搭配活泼有趣的手绘剧情动画，展现出松弛浓厚的生活气息。每集通过记录极具地方风格的美食，覆盖城市历史与文化，以诙谐风趣的讲述方式，探寻深藏市井的极致地方味儿。“Eating in Shaoxing” is a food documentary that explores the rich food culture of Shaoxing. Each episode focuses on one of the six regions—Yuecheng, Keqiao, Zhuji, Shengzhou,...

programme.title: 牛奶是部文明史 / Milk - A Running River of Civilization Episode 4
programme.desc: 首部聚焦牛奶的大型美食人文纪录片，深入探讨牛奶在人类历史与文化中的重要地位。通过科学知识、生动故事和真实情感，展现牛奶的营养、美味及其对人类生活的深远影响，揭示其在不同文化中的独特价值和意义。Food series “Milk – A Running River of Civilization” is the world’s first major food and culture documentary focused on milk, exploring its vital role in human history and culture. Blending science, vivid stories, and real emotion, it highlights milk’s nutrition, taste, and profound impact on human life.

programme.title: 花轿喜事 / Wrong Carriage Right Groom Episode 18
programme.desc: 这天在扬州城有两个小姐同时出嫁了，一个是城中富商的小姐杜冰雁，一个是城中武师的女儿李玉湖。两位小姐都有着外人看似美满的姻缘，冰雁将嫁给柳州巨商齐府的三公子齐天磊，而玉湖将嫁给当朝的重臣袁不屈大将军，但其中的苦水只有她们自己知道。齐天磊体弱多病，为了冲喜才赶着完成婚事；而袁不屈之前在李家受尽白眼，为了报复才决意要娶玉湖。正当两位小姐在花轿上暗自垂泪的时候，突然下起了滂沱大雨。两队娶亲的队伍同时躲到了同一座庙里躲雨，岂料雨过天晴后轿夫竟然抬错了花轿，于是两段离奇曲折的姻缘开始了 。

programme.title: 嗨放派第四季 / Have Fun Season 4 Episode 9
programme.desc: 《嗨放派》是一档奇趣实验类真人秀综艺节目，多位艺人嘉宾将开启十天荒岛生存挑战，比如需要自食其力体验搭建帐篷、自制淋浴间、起火烧饭、自制做饭器具等挑战，最后还要举行一场别开生面的海岛运动会，用最好玩的方式将科学实践到生活里头。“Have Fun” returns for a fourth season! The very well-received China variety again sees popular artistes teaming up to escape the constraints and pressures of city life and having fun through exploring interesting scientific topics and real-life Science experiments, this time on a remote island looking for survival!

programme.title: 一城一味·八闽有鲜味 / One City One Taste. Fujian Episode 5
programme.desc: 《一城一味·八闽有鲜味》，美食年番“一城一味”系列本季“八闽有鲜味”以福州为核心，以鲜味为指引，辐射周围的泉州、漳州、莆田、宁德、平潭等极具美食、人文、自然特色，且用户好奇度高的城市，寻觅最能代表当地特色的鲜味美食，突出食材鲜、做法鲜、味道鲜、佐料鲜的八闽鲜味。也通过一个个不同的美食与美食背后的故事，让观众感受到这些城市的温度与魅力。

programme.title: 幸运的我们 / Suji & Uri Episode 52
programme.desc: 秀智是太阳医院的精神科医生，也是综艺节目的名人。除了提供医疗服务外，她也会出演节目，甚至出席宣传活动，一天都没有超过三小时的睡眠。不过她一直绚丽的人生却从新医生蔡友理的出现开始塌下。蔡医生不但有才华，也幽默正义。因此，视病人的理解和信任为最重要的蔡医生，觉得秀智是个自我中心，只顾自身利益的人，两人简直是医院里的敌人。不过当秀智因为不同传闻而消失的时候，友理反而开始理解她的痛苦。形同敌人的两人到底最后会发生什么事呢？Jin Soo Ji is a superstar psychiatrist at Haedeul Hospital, juggling fame and a hectic schedule of TV shows, book tours, and fan events, leaving her with barely three hours of sleep a day. programme.title: 春色寄情人 / Will Love In Spring Episode 7
programme.desc: 陈麦冬年少时性格桀骜，遭遇生活变故后选择成为一名遗体整容师。庄洁则因车祸致残，为了追逐更好的自己，孤身在外打拼成为大城市之中的职场精英。一个是性格桀骜但身心孤独的遗体整容师，一个是身体缺陷但勇敢耀眼的医疗销售，在不断拉扯中逐渐互相理解与尊重，以爱治愈了彼此的“不完美”。

programme.title: 枭起青壤 / Love on the Turquoise Land
programme.desc: 作家聂夕因看了一场山海经主题的展览产生灵感，书写出一部极具东方色彩的都市奇幻小说。小说中讲述了隐秘的民间异能组织“南山猎人”中疯刀聂九罗与阳光正直，忍辱负重多年的炎拓，不打不相识，经历几次过命合作后，逐渐产生信任和好感，共同对抗地枭，守护爱与和平并终成眷属的故事。It tells the story of a secret organization of supernatural abilities called "Nanshan Hunters." programme.title: 型男大主厨 / Stylish Man Episode 839
programme.desc: 台湾广受欢迎的常青美食料理节目，由2006年始播至今，2011年还获选金钟奖的最佳综合节目主持人奖。每一期将有不同的主题：“大明星來下廚”由兩位明星或两个明星档分組對抗，拿出自己的拿手菜對抗比拼；“五分钟出好菜”由两位厨师根据指定食材，在五分钟内烹煮出易学美味的一道菜等。这是一个富有娱乐效果的轻松美食节目，能够持续制作这么多年不是没有理由的。

programme.title: 舌尖上的绍兴 / Eating in Shaoxing Episode 5
programme.desc: 《舌尖上的绍兴》是一部深度挖掘绍兴地区美食人文的纪录片。每一集讲述绍兴一个地域独特的地方口味和生活特色，分别围绕绍兴越城、柯桥、诸暨、嵊州、新昌、上虞六个区域的不同地域文化背景和美食特色，挖掘当地特有的饮食文化，探寻绍兴人不同的饮食结构与生活方式。以美食+文旅为出发点，凸显地方烟火气，地域自然风貌、人文传承和美食之间的关系，充分展示其地方饮食口味，看到绍兴充满文化气质的生活方式，更能看到城市的历史、文化和环境的印记。 这部纪录片节奏紧凑，画面风格清新且贴近生活。通过真实质朴的纪录手法，搭配活泼有趣的手绘剧情动画，展现出松弛浓厚的生活气息。每集通过记录极具地方风格的美食，覆盖城市历史与文化，以诙谐风趣的讲述方式，探寻深藏市井的极致地方味儿。“Eating in Shaoxing” is a food documentary that explores the rich food culture of Shaoxing. Each episode focuses on one of the six regions—Yuecheng, Keqiao, Zhuji, Shengzhou,...

programme.title: 牛奶是部文明史 / Milk - A Running River of Civilization Episode 5
programme.desc: 首部聚焦牛奶的大型美食人文纪录片，深入探讨牛奶在人类历史与文化中的重要地位。通过科学知识、生动故事和真实情感，展现牛奶的营养、美味及其对人类生活的深远影响，揭示其在不同文化中的独特价值和意义。Food series “Milk – A Running River of Civilization” is the world’s first major food and culture documentary focused on milk, exploring its vital role in human history and culture. Blending science, vivid stories, and real emotion, it highlights milk’s nutrition, taste, and profound impact on human life.

programme.title: 舌尖上的绍兴 / Eating in Shaoxing Episode 5
programme.desc: 《舌尖上的绍兴》是一部深度挖掘绍兴地区美食人文的纪录片。每一集讲述绍兴一个地域独特的地方口味和生活特色，分别围绕绍兴越城、柯桥、诸暨、嵊州、新昌、上虞六个区域的不同地域文化背景和美食特色，挖掘当地特有的饮食文化，探寻绍兴人不同的饮食结构与生活方式。以美食+文旅为出发点，凸显地方烟火气，地域自然风貌、人文传承和美食之间的关系，充分展示其地方饮食口味，看到绍兴充满文化气质的生活方式，更能看到城市的历史、文化和环境的印记。 这部纪录片节奏紧凑，画面风格清新且贴近生活。通过真实质朴的纪录手法，搭配活泼有趣的手绘剧情动画，展现出松弛浓厚的生活气息。每集通过记录极具地方风格的美食，覆盖城市历史与文化，以诙谐风趣的讲述方式，探寻深藏市井的极致地方味儿。“Eating in Shaoxing” is a food documentary that explores the rich food culture of Shaoxing. Each episode focuses on one of the six regions—Yuecheng, Keqiao, Zhuji, Shengzhou,...

programme.title: 牛奶是部文明史 / Milk - A Running River of Civilization Episode 5
programme.desc: 首部聚焦牛奶的大型美食人文纪录片，深入探讨牛奶在人类历史与文化中的重要地位。通过科学知识、生动故事和真实情感，展现牛奶的营养、美味及其对人类生活的深远影响，揭示其在不同文化中的独特价值和意义。Food series “Milk – A Running River of Civilization” is the world’s first major food and culture documentary focused on milk, exploring its vital role in human history and culture. Blending science, vivid stories, and real emotion, it highlights milk’s nutrition, taste, and profound impact on human life.

programme.title: 追风者 / War of Faith Episode 31

programme.title: 花轿喜事 / Wrong Carriage Right Groom Episode 18
programme.desc: 这天在扬州城有两个小姐同时出嫁了，一个是城中富商的小姐杜冰雁，一个是城中武师的女儿李玉湖。两位小姐都有着外人看似美满的姻缘，冰雁将嫁给柳州巨商齐府的三公子齐天磊，而玉湖将嫁给当朝的重臣袁不屈大将军，但其中的苦水只有她们自己知道。齐天磊体弱多病，为了冲喜才赶着完成婚事；而袁不屈之前在李家受尽白眼，为了报复才决意要娶玉湖。正当两位小姐在花轿上暗自垂泪的时候，突然下起了滂沱大雨。两队娶亲的队伍同时躲到了同一座庙里躲雨，岂料雨过天晴后轿夫竟然抬错了花轿，于是两段离奇曲折的姻缘开始了 。

programme.title: 花轿喜事 / Wrong Carriage Right Groom Episode 19
programme.desc: 这天在扬州城有两个小姐同时出嫁了，一个是城中富商的小姐杜冰雁，一个是城中武师的女儿李玉湖。两位小姐都有着外人看似美满的姻缘，冰雁将嫁给柳州巨商齐府的三公子齐天磊，而玉湖将嫁给当朝的重臣袁不屈大将军，但其中的苦水只有她们自己知道。齐天磊体弱多病，为了冲喜才赶着完成婚事；而袁不屈之前在李家受尽白眼，为了报复才决意要娶玉湖。正当两位小姐在花轿上暗自垂泪的时候，突然下起了滂沱大雨。两队娶亲的队伍同时躲到了同一座庙里躲雨，岂料雨过天晴后轿夫竟然抬错了花轿，于是两段离奇曲折的姻缘开始了 。

programme.desc: 《书卷一梦》讲述了一百八十线女演员宋小鱼，意外穿越进剧本世界成为女主角宋一梦，遇到阴狠绝情的大男主南珩，两人上演了一个又一个剧本名场面，始终逃不过厄运，也逃不脱彼此。随着与南珩接触的日益加深，这场纸片人与既定命运抗争的改命之旅，也徐徐拉开了帷幕，究竟结局是否早已定局或还能被改写，无人知晓…What would you do if you accidentally cross over into the world of script, and become the heroine who is abandoned and abused to death by the villainous hero, time and again? programme.title: 幸运的我们 / Suji & Uri Episode 70
programme.desc: 秀智是太阳医院的精神科医生，也是综艺节目的名人。除了提供医疗服务外，她也会出演节目，甚至出席宣传活动，一天都没有超过三小时的睡眠。不过她一直绚丽的人生却从新医生蔡友理的出现开始塌下。蔡医生不但有才华，也幽默正义。因此，视病人的理解和信任为最重要的蔡医生，觉得秀智是个自我中心，只顾自身利益的人，两人简直是医院里的敌人。不过当秀智因为不同传闻而消失的时候，友理反而开始理解她的痛苦。形同敌人的两人到底最后会发生什么事呢？Jin Soo Ji is a superstar psychiatrist at Haedeul Hospital, juggling fame and a hectic schedule of TV shows, book tours, and fan events, leaving her with barely three hours of sleep a day. programme.title: 追风者 / War of Faith Episode 33

programme.desc: 秀智是太阳医院的精神科医生，也是综艺节目的名人。除了提供医疗服务外，她也会出演节目，甚至出席宣传活动，一天都没有超过三小时的睡眠。不过她一直绚丽的人生却从新医生蔡友理的出现开始塌下。蔡医生不但有才华，也幽默正义。因此，视病人的理解和信任为最重要的蔡医生，觉得秀智是个自我中心，只顾自身利益的人，两人简直是医院里的敌人。不过当秀智因为不同传闻而消失的时候，友理反而开始理解她的痛苦。形同敌人的两人到底最后会发生什么事呢？Jin Soo Ji is a superstar psychiatrist at Haedeul Hospital, juggling fame and a hectic schedule of TV shows, book tours, and fan events, leaving her with barely three hours of sleep a day. programme.title: 花轿喜事 / Wrong Carriage Right Groom Episode 21

programme.desc: 第四季以谷物为视角重新审视我们美味的星球，挖掘展现世界美食地图，从美食中折射出世界各地的美食智慧与中国人个性的独特侧面。将以全人类的视角放眼整个地球，寻找世界范围内正在发生的谷物与人类共生的故事、多样美食与谷物之间的碰撞，透过这些故事我们可以窥见农业诞生至今的一万年中，人类与食物之间相互塑造的传奇。

programme.title: 追风者 / War of Faith Episode 35

programme.title: 型男大主厨 / Stylish Man Episode 839
programme.desc: 台湾广受欢迎的常青美食料理节目，由2006年始播至今，2011年还获选金钟奖的最佳综合节目主持人奖。每一期将有不同的主题：“大明星來下廚”由兩位明星或两个明星档分組對抗，拿出自己的拿手菜對抗比拼；“五分钟出好菜”由两位厨师根据指定食材，在五分钟内烹煮出易学美味的一道菜等。这是一个富有娱乐效果的轻松美食节目，能够持续制作这么多年不是没有理由的。

programme.title: 舌尖上的绍兴 / Eating in Shaoxing Episode 5
programme.desc: 《舌尖上的绍兴》是一部深度挖掘绍兴地区美食人文的纪录片。每一集讲述绍兴一个地域独特的地方口味和生活特色，分别围绕绍兴越城、柯桥、诸暨、嵊州、新昌、上虞六个区域的不同地域文化背景和美食特色，挖掘当地特有的饮食文化，探寻绍兴人不同的饮食结构与生活方式。以美食+文旅为出发点，凸显地方烟火气，地域自然风貌、人文传承和美食之间的关系，充分展示其地方饮食口味，看到绍兴充满文化气质的生活方式，更能看到城市的历史、文化和环境的印记。 这部纪录片节奏紧凑，画面风格清新且贴近生活。通过真实质朴的纪录手法，搭配活泼有趣的手绘剧情动画，展现出松弛浓厚的生活气息。每集通过记录极具地方风格的美食，覆盖城市历史与文化，以诙谐风趣的讲述方式，探寻深藏市井的极致地方味儿。“Eating in Shaoxing” is a food documentary that explores the rich food culture of Shaoxing. Each episode focuses on one of the six regions—Yuecheng, Keqiao, Zhuji, Shengzhou,...

programme.title: 牛奶是部文明史 / Milk - A Running River of Civilization Episode 5
programme.desc: 首部聚焦牛奶的大型美食人文纪录片，深入探讨牛奶在人类历史与文化中的重要地位。通过科学知识、生动故事和真实情感，展现牛奶的营养、美味及其对人类生活的深远影响，揭示其在不同文化中的独特价值和意义。Food series “Milk – A Running River of Civilization” is the world’s first major food and culture documentary focused on milk, exploring its vital role in human history and culture. Blending science, vivid stories, and real emotion, it highlights milk’s nutrition, taste, and profound impact on human life.

programme.title: 幸运的我们 / Suji & Uri Episode 76
programme.desc: 秀智是太阳医院的精神科医生，也是综艺节目的名人。除了提供医疗服务外，她也会出演节目，甚至出席宣传活动，一天都没有超过三小时的睡眠。不过她一直绚丽的人生却从新医生蔡友理的出现开始塌下。蔡医生不但有才华，也幽默正义。因此，视病人的理解和信任为最重要的蔡医生，觉得秀智是个自我中心，只顾自身利益的人，两人简直是医院里的敌人。不过当秀智因为不同传闻而消失的时候，友理反而开始理解她的痛苦。形同敌人的两人到底最后会发生什么事呢？Jin Soo Ji is a superstar psychiatrist at Haedeul Hospital, juggling fame and a hectic schedule of TV shows, book tours, and fan events, leaving her with barely three hours of sleep a day. programme.title: 花轿喜事 / Wrong Carriage Right Groom Episode 23
programme.desc: 这天在扬州城有两个小姐同时出嫁了，一个是城中富商的小姐杜冰雁，一个是城中武师的女儿李玉湖。两位小姐都有着外人看似美满的姻缘，冰雁将嫁给柳州巨商齐府的三公子齐天磊，而玉湖将嫁给当朝的重臣袁不屈大将军，但其中的苦水只有她们自己知道。齐天磊体弱多病，为了冲喜才赶着完成婚事；而袁不屈之前在李家受尽白眼，为了报复才决意要娶玉湖。正当两位小姐在花轿上暗自垂泪的时候，突然下起了滂沱大雨。两队娶亲的队伍同时躲到了同一座庙里躲雨，岂料雨过天晴后轿夫竟然抬错了花轿，于是两段离奇曲折的姻缘开始了 。

programme.title: 书卷一梦 / A Dream Within a Dream Episode 9
programme.desc: 《书卷一梦》讲述了一百八十线女演员宋小鱼，意外穿越进剧本世界成为女主角宋一梦，遇到阴狠绝情的大男主南珩，两人上演了一个又一个剧本名场面，始终逃不过厄运，也逃不脱彼此。随着与南珩接触的日益加深，这场纸片人与既定命运抗争的改命之旅，也徐徐拉开了帷幕，究竟结局是否早已定局或还能被改写，无人知晓…What would you do if you accidentally cross over into the world of script, and become the heroine who is abandoned and abused to death by the villainous hero, time and again? programme.title: MEGA Fights Episode 21
programme.desc: MEGA Fights are premiere events from the sport of boxing including HBO World Championship Boxing, historic PPV events plus past, current and future World Champions. This episode features middleweights Sergio 'Maravilla' Martinez (47-2, 26 KOs) vs. 'Dazzling' Darren Barker (23-0, 14 KOs) from Boardwalk Hall in Atlantic City, New Jersey, USA, on October 1, 2011. An 11th round knockout decided this bout between 2 of the top 4 contenders in the deep middleweight class.

programme.title: Wide World of Fights Episode 12
programme.desc: This episode features Floyd Mayweather, in one of his toughest fights yet, challenging Miguel Cotto for the WBA super light middleweight title, as well as kickboxing, sumo and more!

programme.title: KNOCKOUTS! Episode 37
programme.desc: The main event in this episode is Jhonny Gonzalez defending the WBO bantamweight title against Gerry Penalosa. A left hook to the body ends the fight. Also on the card, a controversial ending to the Nate Campbell / Ali Funeka brawl.

programme.title: FS Grand Sumo
programme.desc: For the first time the top ranked sumo competitors in the world are featured in an action packed series, FIGHT SPORTS GRAND SUMO. Show 1 featuring Hakuho, Tochiozan, Shodai and Ichinojo from the Hatsu basho, 2019.

programme.title: Judo for the World Episode 15

Plus we catch up with Japan's brother and sister superstars, the Abe's.

programme.title: Pariah: Sonny Liston Episode 3
programme.desc: Was Sonny Liston murdered? This four-part documentary series explores the life and untimely death of boxing legend Charles 'Sonny' Liston, who became the heavyweight champion of the world when he knocked out Floyd Patterson in 1962. Unfortunately, just eight years later, he was found dead in his Las Vegas home from an alleged heroin overdose. Suspicion regarding the real cause of his death has continued to this day. Episode 3 of 4.

programme.title: Bear Grylls: Mission Survive Episode 2

At the end of an action-packed day, one more member of the group faces elimination.

programme.title: Wild City: Forest Life
programme.desc: Sir David Attenborough narrates the award-winning Wild City series that explores the wild side of Singapore. Here on the fringes of the city, the jungle harbours some fascinating species, including many that have never been filmed before. The star of the show is the Raffles' banded langur, one of the least-known primates on the planet. Found only in Singapore and Malaysia, there are only a few hundred left and around 60 have made a home in Singapore's rainforests.

programme.title: Mountain Men (S12) Episode 6
programme.desc: Jake spends the night in the mountains after his snowmobile breaks down. Paul traps for mink and pine marten. Eustace helps a friend buy and assemble an antique sawmill.

programme.title: Dark Marvels Episode 4
programme.desc: The gates are open to some of history's most sinister structures. From the terrifying Tower of London to a hotel of horrors, discover the dark secrets hidden within these foreboding fortresses.

programme.title: History's Greatest Escapes With Morgan Freeman (S2) Episode 13
programme.desc: During the Civil War, a daring prison break frees hundreds of Union soldiers. When he was captured and sent to Libby Prison in Richmond, Virginia, he engineered one of the greatest mass escapes in history.

programme.title: Forged In Fire (S10) Episode 14
programme.desc: In this special competition, two previous champions go head-to-head in a 5-hour forging round, making their own signature 'can mai' blades for the chance to compete against one of our titans of the forge.

programme.title: Mountain Men (S12) Episode 6
programme.desc: Jake spends the night in the mountains after his snowmobile breaks down. Paul traps for mink and pine marten. Eustace helps a friend buy and assemble an antique sawmill.

programme.title: History's Greatest Mysteries (S4) Episode 7
programme.desc: In 1930, a New York Supreme Court justice with close ties to Tammany Hall, and future president Franklin Delano Roosevelt, steps out of a steakhouse and disappears.

programme.title: Hazardous History With Henry Winkler (S1) Episode 7
programme.desc: Snack on a feast of food horrors from the past: from radioactive energy drinks to scandalous snacks made with Olestra, we uncover the incredible things people once ate without a second thought.

programme.title: Pawn Stars (S23) Episode 52
programme.desc: Movie props from the world of 007 along with real life code cracking devices and secret guns come in from the cold to the pawn shop.

programme.title: The Secret Of Skinwalker Ranch (S4) Episode 3
programme.desc: After discovering new evidence of massive metallic objects buried beneath the Mesa, the team conducts an experiment at the Triangle that leads to one of the most shocking revelations on Skinwalker Ranch.

programme.title: History's Greatest Mysteries (S4) Episode 17
programme.desc: It is an ancient city, said to be overflowing with gold. Explorers put their lives on the line searching for it. As the endless quest to uncover this infamous city continues, will anyone ever find it?

programme.title: Holy Marvels With Dennis Quaid (S2) Episode 14
programme.desc: From the legendary blades of ancient kings to a divine arsenal said to annihilate monsters, history is filled with tales of iconic sacred weapons. In this episode, we delve into how they were crafted.

programme.title: Asia's Special Forces With Terry Schappert
programme.desc: Hosted by U.S Special Forces legend, Terry Schappert, this 4-part special showcases the toughest training segments from History's original Special Forces series.

programme.title: Asia's Special Forces With Terry Schappert Episode 2
programme.desc: Hosted by U.S Special Forces legend, Terry Schappert, this 4-part special showcases the toughest training segments from History's original Special Forces series.

programme.title: The Death Coast Episode 6
programme.desc: Following the trail of a cache of precious gemstones, Jeff and the team move further beyond the breakers, in search of The Neptune. With stormy weather closing in, a new find may lead them one step closer.

programme.title: Divas Episode 3
programme.desc: A biographical documentary about the incredible life and career of one of the most charismatic personalities in film, theatre and music: Liza Minnelli.

programme.title: Divas Episode 4
programme.desc: One of the greatest performers of our time, Tina Turner, has captured the hearts and souls of millions around the world with her powerful voice, electrifying stage presence, and inspiring life story.

programme.title: Air Warriors S10 Episode 2
programme.desc: Discover how and why the fighter-bomber Panavia Tornado has been so useful in so many roles for so many years.

programme.title: Air Warriors S10 Episode 3
programme.desc: Witness the fighter-bomber F-111 in action, from the jungle battles of Vietnam to the desert wars of the Middle East.

programme.title: Visionaries ft. Keanu Reeves Episode 6
programme.desc: Keanu and Gard meet Mattie Rodrigue, the lead scientific researcher on OceanX. Mattie and her team explore the unknown ocean, and their work reveals how nature inspires everything we do.

programme.title: Visionaries ft. Keanu Reeves Episode 7
programme.desc: In Norway, visionary architect Kjetil Thorsen is redefining the way we think about buildings and architecture with an Opera House that you can walk on and a restaurant that plunges into the sea.

programme.title: Visionaries ft. Keanu Reeves Episode 8
programme.desc: The Arch journey is about curiosity - understanding why inspiration strikes. After meeting with visionaries around the world, Keanu and Gard return to Arch to debrief the lessons learned.

programme.title: Visionaries ft. Keanu Reeves
programme.desc: Keanu and Gard meet Tim Ellis. A young CEO, Tim is the founder of Relativity Space, the company that built and launched the world's first 3D printed rocket.

programme.title: Oceans Africa Episode 3
programme.desc: In A 'Tale Of Two Sharks' we take a look at the incredible array of sharks found off the South African coast, focusing on the endangered Scalloped Hammerhead and the iconic Great White.

programme.title: Wildest Survival S2
programme.desc: Meet the extraordinary miniature animals, who use their small size to survive against all odds in the world's most deadly environments.

programme.title: Destination Flavour: China Episode 7
programme.desc: Adam Liaw arrives to the fiery provinces of Sichuan and Hunan and this time he's joined by celebrated chef and author Fuchsia Dunlop who is an expert on the region.

programme.title: Destination Flavour: China Episode 8
programme.desc: Adam Liaw is in Fujian - a place with a long history of migration where the movement of people left an enduring mark that manifested in its food and culture.

programme.title: Destination Flavour: China Episode 9
programme.desc: Adam Liaw heads to the home of Cantonese cuisine - Hong Kong and Guangdong to discover the regional cuisine that spread to all corners of the world.

programme.title: Destination Flavour: China Episode 10
programme.desc: Adam Liaw's last stop is the very special Hainan Island - a balmy, tropical island and Adam's ancestral home.

programme.title: Ainsley Eats The Streets
programme.desc: On the first leg of his journey, Ainsley heads to Istanbul, where he encounters slow-roasted sheep's head, season Turkish village food, like loquats stuffed with cumin-spiced meatballs, and braised lamb with young figs.

programme.title: Ainsley Eats The Streets Episode 2
programme.desc: Ainsley visits the Caribbean, where he ventures down the backstreets in search of the true local food. He spends time with the locals, cooks roti on the beach with Mr Delicious, fries up spectacular fishcakes, and tries the hottest hot sauce ever.

programme.title: Leguizamo Does America Episode 6
programme.desc: John starts his trip by driving to east L.A. with native Angelino, George Lopez.

programme.title: A New Zealand Food Story S4
programme.desc: Ben's food journey starts in the West Coast of the South Island. He meets the only NZ cranberry producer at a farm in Hokitika and travels to Blackball to learn how chorizo is made. He cooks a range of dishes at the beach incorporating these local delicacies, matched with a local beer.

programme.title: A New Zealand Food Story S4 Episode 2
programme.desc: Ben visits High Peak Station in Canterbury and learns of their high -country farm to fork experience and tales of multigenerational stewardship. On the wild Tora Coast he meets a couple who harvest kaimoana sustainably – launching their fishing boat into the sea using a bulldozer.

programme.title: A New Zealand Food Story S4 Episode 3
programme.desc: Ben's travels to Hastings and discovers a holistic fully vertically integrated approach to creating grass fed Angus beef. He ventures to the local farmers market and meets amazing local food producers, reinforcing the abundance of produce grown in the region.

programme.title: A New Zealand Food Story S4 Episode 4
programme.desc: Ben's meets an Orchardist and Food Innovation specialist. They have a shared vision to make all natural varietal – led apple juice, using the best technology in the world. He also checks out over 30 varieties of figs grown in the Mediterranean type climate of Hawkes Bay.

programme.title: Ainsley Eats The Streets Episode 3
programme.desc: Ainsley travels to Reykjavik, Iceland, to discover a truly exciting traditional and modern cuisine. She prepares a local classic of langoustines in garlic butter, and there is also gravadlax and ceviche, malted bread, and cakes cooked in a geyser.

programme.title: Ainsley Eats The Streets Episode 4
programme.desc: Ainsley's street food odyssey concludes in Osaka, where he discovers the art of making okonomiyaki, a bit like an English breakfast wrapped in a pancake, tries tapas Japanese style, and makes oyster tempura and udon noodles with chili prawns.

programme.title: Ainsley Eats The Streets Episode 5
programme.desc: Ainsley travels to Palermo on the Italian island of Sicily and prepares seafood pasta on the beach, using freshly caught tuna; Ainsley samples local delicacies including fried calamari, stuffed sardines and the island's unique recipe for pesto.

programme.title: Ainsley Eats The Streets Episode 6
programme.desc: Ainsley travels to Taiwan and discovers it is one of the greatest food destinations in the world. He finds fragrant braised fish and chilli pork stir-fry, and cooks Taiwan prawns with garlic and chilli.

programme.title: Leguizamo Does America Episode 6
programme.desc: John starts his trip by driving to east L.A. with native Angelino, George Lopez.

programme.title: Iceland: The Puffin Sanctuary
programme.desc: The endearing, "comical" puffin is Iceland's national emblem, but its fate is concerning. For a decade, couples have stopped breeding. A handful of local enthusiasts are now mobilized to save this beloved seabird.

programme.title: Costa Rica: The Rise Of Nature
programme.desc: Join us on a journey to the heart of Costa Rica, to discover several fabulous Eden-like biotopes, and see the unprecedented efforts that are made every day to preserve, and in some cases restore, this exceptional natural heritage.

programme.desc: After the Vietnam War ended in 1975, many Vietnamese people settled down in San Francisco. In this episode we meet several Vietnamese immigrants, learn about their journey to America and tastes their amazing authentic Vietnamese food.

programme.title: United Plates Of America Episode 8
programme.desc: No other cuisine has had such an impact on modern dishes then Italians. Italians arrived here in droves and got straight to work. They are now loved by all, but it wasn't always that way.

programme.title: Space Disasters Episode 4
programme.desc: NASA vigorously trains its astronauts to ensure they are physically fit, mentally strong, and as reliable as the strongest machines. But the fact is, even the brightest of people make mistakes...and in the unforgiving environment of space, any error, even a small one, can have life and death implications.

programme.title: Space Disasters Episode 5
programme.desc: Flying through bad weather can be a harrowing experience, and for NASA, it can be doubly unnerving, as violent storms can strike from below the atmosphere or above it. Witness the true power of nature in space and on Earth as astronauts and ground crews battle to overcome the elements.

programme.title: Space Disasters Episode 6
programme.desc: Sending spacecraft into orbit is an unforgiving business. Every launch is a long, controlled explosion that can turn into a fiery spectacle at the smallest error.

programme.title: Visionaries ft. Keanu Reeves Episode 2
programme.desc: Keanu and Gard are given unprecedented access to one of the world's most guarded artworks: James Turrell's Roden Crater. Inside the volcanic crater, the art explores the use of light and the cosmos.

programme.title: Visionaries ft. Keanu Reeves Episode 3
programme.desc: Keanu and Gard meet Omar Bailey, a shoe designer revolutionizing sneaker culture. Omar's FCTRY LAb has created innovative shoes for musicians and athletes. Now, he'll create a boot inspired by ARCH.

programme.title: Visionaries ft. Keanu Reeves Episode 4
programme.desc: Keanu and Gard travel to Slovenia to meet Igor Akrapovič. Igor's company is an exhaust engineer known by MotoGP legends. As they learn from Igor, Arch will collaborate with him on a new project.

programme.title: Visionaries ft. Keanu Reeves Episode 5
programme.desc: Keanu and Gard meet Paige Bradley, a world-famous sculptor who destroyed her own art to create something new. Using fire and imagination, Paige offers insight into creativity and the artistic process.

programme.title: Visionaries ft. Keanu Reeves Episode 6
programme.desc: Keanu and Gard meet Mattie Rodrigue, the lead scientific researcher on OceanX. Mattie and her team explore the unknown ocean, and their work reveals how nature inspires everything we do.

programme.title: Visionaries ft. Keanu Reeves Episode 7
programme.desc: In Norway, visionary architect Kjetil Thorsen is redefining the way we think about buildings and architecture with an Opera House that you can walk on and a restaurant that plunges into the sea.

programme.title: The Presidents Episode 2
programme.desc: Donald Trump's presidency (2017-2021) was marked by controversy and societal shifts, leaving a lasting impact on the nation and world.

programme.title: My Best Friend's An Animal 1 Episode 6
programme.desc: Embrace an invasive nutria who's become part of the family, paddle around with Gumbo the goose, and visit a blind hedgehog and his human chum. Explore a swimmer's bond with wild gray seals and hang out with Cosima the monkey and Jasper the serval.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters 3 Episode 4
programme.desc: Meet pampered young leopardess Chipadzua, who has never had to hunt for food, thanks to her patient mother. Alone for the first time in her life, will she develop the skills it takes to survive?

programme.title: Dogs with Extraordinary Jobs 1
programme.desc: Dogs around the world come to the rescue in surprising ways. Some search for survivors when disaster strikes or rescue animals from poachers and wildlife traffickers. Others help us in times of trouble—both on land and in the water.

programme.title: Dogs with Extraordinary Jobs 1 Episode 2
programme.desc: Meet a border collie that protects aircraft from lethal bird strikes, a sprocker spaniel whose sense of smell is saving imperilled water voles, and an Anatolian shepherd that helps conserve Africa's most endangered big cat, the cheetah.

programme.title: Wild Pacific Rescue 1 Episode 3
programme.desc: Follow the team in healing and releasing a grumpy sea turtle, and then meet a sea lion with an unusual injury that must be taken by crane to the rescue centre. Find out how the vet aids an aging fruit bat and a community rescues a one-eyed seal pup.

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit 1 Episode 5
programme.desc: Storm into a new suburb, where the wranglers keep deadly snakes from slipping into family homes. Watch as Stu and Liv pull an eastern brown from a job site, Jess and Dan expel a python from a shed, and Mick and Adele evict a red belly from a bedroom.

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit 1 Episode 6
programme.desc: Respond to danger on a rural property with Mick and Adele, who brave a fired-up brown snake. Tread carefully as Jess and Dan extract a python from a play area, and get spooked when a chicken-hunting python squashes Liv's hand during a tense rescue.

programme.title: After the Wildfires
programme.desc: Examine fire's pivotal role in shaping Australia's natural world. Tour the devastation left by 2020's brutal bush-fire season, learn how climate change fuelled this watershed event, and chart the long-term recovery of the continent's wildlife.

programme.title: Wild Dogs: Pack vs. Pride 2
programme.desc: Return to South Luangwa to see the new pups born to the mighty Manzi and the tiny-but-fearless Kakumbi packs. See yearling Snowy face a hungry hyena before a lion pride scatters Manzi mum Weka's pups and leaves her frantically searching for them.

programme.title: Wild Castles 1
programme.desc: Explore beautiful Heidelberg Castle whose ruins stand in imposing wonder beside the river Neckar in Western Germany. Surrounded by a protected nature reserve, the castle is home to birds of prey and acts as a spawning ground for nearby amphibians.

programme.title: Wild Castles 1 Episode 2
programme.desc: Travel to a centuries-old French fortress, home to some of history's greatest empires. Carcassone, once a center of wealth and culture, is now a haven for wildlife. Birds, wild boar, and armies of insects endure in its bountiful surroundings.

programme.title: Wild Castles 1 Episode 3
programme.desc: Discover the world's largest castle carved into a cave. Predjama, in Slovenia, has provided protection not only for its Medieval human inhabitants, but also serves as a haven for the birds, boars, and mountain goats that live in the region.

programme.title: Wild Castles 1 Episode 4
programme.desc: Tour the marvelous Alhambra, a must-see fortress in Spain's Grenada region. Today this world heritage site acts as a refuge for the region's wildlife. With its many streams and fountains, Alhambra serves amphibian, fish, and bird alike.

programme.title: Wild Castles 1 Episode 5
programme.desc: Learn how one of the world's most spectacular structures, Neuschwanstein castle, and its surrounding forests have become home base for many creatures. From the Alpine ibex to the majestic swans, this castle has been a natural haven for centuries.

programme.title: Animals at Play 1
programme.desc: Explore the ways that animals use play, including young gibbons in Thailand that practice falling from branches, elderly macaques that preserve their brains with playtime, and games that sharpen the profound intelligence of African elephants.

programme.title: Animals at Play 1 Episode 2
programme.desc: Young hyenas compete in tug of war, mischievous parrots play at picking apart tourists' cars, and Atlantic spotted dolphins enjoy sophisticated social games amid seaweed—all following specific rules that hone social bonds.

programme.title: My Best Friend's An Animal 1 Episode 2
programme.desc: Learn how cockatoos and platypuses inspired new careers, then explore the shared trauma that bonded a human and an elephant for life. Get playful with 35-year-old George the turkey vulture and say a moving farewell to human-raised kangaroos.

programme.title: My Best Friend's An Animal 1 Episode 3
programme.desc: Explore Tasmanian devils' softer side, meet a pioneering sea turtle, and enjoy family dinner with Buttons the deer. Play football with 800-kilogram Spud the bull and learn how Digger the owl soothed conservationist Nigel during his cancer treatment.

programme.title: My Best Friend's An Animal 1 Episode 4
programme.desc: Flap around with Banksi the fruit bat and his human surrogate mom, eye a mischievous emu, and celebrate a pig's rescue-versary. Tour manatee heaven and learn to speak baboon with Dingani, who has a one-of-a-kind kinship with his primate pal Lucy.

programme.title: My Best Friend's An Animal 1 Episode 5
programme.desc: Visit Penny the pigeon and the human who saved her, get a buzz from a refugee who found comfort in beekeeping, and see celebrity groundhogs. Dive with a shark dancer and feel touched by the deep, lifelong commitment Riana has to Faith the cheetah.

programme.title: My Best Friend's An Animal 1 Episode 6
programme.desc: Embrace an invasive nutria who's become part of the family, paddle around with Gumbo the goose, and visit a blind hedgehog and his human chum. Explore a swimmer's bond with wild gray seals and hang out with Cosima the monkey and Jasper the serval.

programme.title: How the Wild Things Sleep
programme.desc: Tap into one of the least understood areas of animal science: sleep. Check out adaptations made by the most extreme snoozers on Earth, from tiny bees who doze for 20 hours a day to enormous elephants who survive on just two precious hours of rest.

programme.title: The Great Elephant Tale
programme.desc: Follow the adventures of three elephants across three very distinct African habitats. Their travels combine to tell the story of how these emotional and intelligent creatures evolved over millions of years to survive on the continent.

programme.title: Becoming Elephant: the Orphans of Reteti 1
programme.desc: Explore community-run Reteti Elephant Sanctuary, where human surrogate moms offer survival lessons and nurture young elephants through play. Bond with trunkless Long'uro and see why six-year-old Kelele's mysterious illness could delay his release.

programme.title: Becoming Elephant: the Orphans of Reteti 1 Episode 2
programme.desc: Balance the pain of goodbyes with hope for the future as a generation of rescued elephants are finally released. Welcome new additions to the Reteti family, including a baby elephant rescued from a watering hole and a traumatized zebra named Kisima.

programme.title: Becoming Orangutan 1
programme.desc: Welcome baby orangutan Topan, an orphan in need of a surrogate mom. Watch her learning journey in nursery school while her fellow students move through junior, senior, and wild-immersion schools. Meanwhile, 16-year-old Kasper preps for graduation.

programme.title: Becoming Orangutan 1 Episode 2
programme.desc: Observe blossoming friendships and interspecies bonds in nursery school, and peek inside a bromance among junior-school buds Valentino, Yutris and Madara. See distractible Beni lean into his love of food and get a beating from a more-senior pupil.

programme.title: Becoming Orangutan 1 Episode 3
programme.desc: Experience a roller coaster of emotions and growing pains as the sanctuary's orangutans move through six grades toward their release into the wild. Discover how Dilla's fate suddenly changes, and watch as big boy Beni goes on an unwelcome diet.

programme.title: How the Wild Things Sleep

programme.desc: Experience a roller coaster of emotions and growing pains as the sanctuary's orangutans move through six grades toward their release into the wild. Discover how Dilla's fate suddenly changes, and watch as big boy Beni goes on an unwelcome diet.

programme.title: Wild Dogs: Pack vs. Pride 2 Episode 2
programme.desc: Run into a lion-hyena showdown with Julz as he hunts for the elusive Manzi pack, who are missing four of their precious pups. Then join Henry from the Zambian Carnivore Programme on a house call to the Kakumbi den, where another pup has gone AWOL.

programme.title: Into the Wild Colombia 1
programme.desc: Growing up in the rainforests in the heart of Colombia, a young capuchin monkey has to master his climbing skills, learn how to find food and learn to distinguish friend from foe.

programme.title: Into the Wild Colombia 1 Episode 2
programme.desc: From Colombia's high plains of the Páramo to its tropical forests, hummingbirds have evolved into an extraordinary number of species. Whether battling freezing rain or jungle predators, each mother must struggle to build a nest, protect her eggs.

programme.title: Into the Wild Colombia 1 Episode 3
programme.desc: The flat savannas of the Colombian Llanos are governed by seasonal extremes that push life to the brink. In this unforgiving arena, there are no second chances, and only creatures best adapted to their brutal extremes will make it through a year.

programme.title: Into the Wild Colombia 1 Episode 4
programme.desc: Mona, a female cotton top tamarin is all alone in her tropical forest home. She has left the security of her birth family to search for an unrelated troop which might provide her with a future mate.

programme.title: Into the Wild Colombia 1 Episode 5
programme.desc: This is the story of Julieta, a female golden dart frog, in search of her Romeo. She's about to lay her eggs and must find a male to fertilize them. Romeo's calls guide her through the forest, but crossing the dense rainforest is no easy feat.

programme.title: Over Australia 1
programme.desc: From the vast, dry plains of the interior come some of Australia's most recognized imagery, such as the monolithic red rock of Uluru and the bounding red kangaroo. But how did the arid center of the continent come to be?

programme.title: Over Australia 1 Episode 2
programme.desc: Created by titanic forces and spanning 3,700 km along the eastern edge of Australia, the Great Dividing Range separates two very different worlds. Aerial footage and intimate studies reveal how species survive and thrive in this mountain home.

programme.title: Land of Primates 1 Episode 8
programme.desc: Off the coast of Tanzania, baby Kima lives with his family of red Colobus monkeys. But what happens when he loses his way? Discover how this little monkey learns to adapt to life in the jungle—and find out if he can reconnect with his family again.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters 3
programme.desc: While the dominant males roam nearby territories, hunting duties fall to the Mwamba pride's nine strong lionesses. See how they cope with the approach of the rainy season and six growing teenagers with boundless appetites.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters 3 Episode 2
programme.desc: As the lionesses set out to recover the males who are needed to hunt buffalo, they must cross a crocodile-infested river. Follow Milo, the only cub in the mighty Mwamba pride, as he's saved from snapping jaws and cements the family's future.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters 3 Episode 3
programme.desc: If the tiny Nsefu pride is to survive, the teen Misfit and his older brother must quickly perfect their hunting skills. Trek into enemy territory as the lions face dominant rivals and a powerful hyena clan in the search for prey.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters 3 Episode 4
programme.desc: Meet pampered young leopardess Chipadzua, who has never had to hunt for food, thanks to her patient mother. Alone for the first time in her life, will she develop the skills it takes to survive?

programme.title: Macro Worlds 1
programme.desc: As soon as the days get cold and dark insects begin to disappear from the meadows and fields. Their sum and hum slowly fades away and will finally be gone. All animals have their special ways to survive winter. Migrating birds like swallows and cranes fly towards south, a lot of mammals like deer get a thick winter fur or hide away and sleep where it's warm. But what do insects do? And why are they all back in spring?

programme.title: Macro Worlds 1 Episode 2
programme.desc: It is horror! It is murder! Brutal death as well as exciting fights with an exceptional last-minute rescue. And after seeing it – you will know the creepiest spot is actually the meadow in your neighborhood. With stylistic devices from the horror genre this extraordinary nature documentary takes you on a journey following a well-known hero with six legs, red wings and seven black dots through a seemingly normal meadow – but full of monsters.

programme.title: A Bee's Diary
programme.desc: In a beehive, tens of thousands of tiny animals work toward a common goal: the survival of the colony. But what is life like for an individual honeybee? A Bee's Diary tells that story.

programme.title: Bugs That Rule the World 1
programme.desc: Look at what a global insect decline could do to our planet. Uncover our historical dependence on these tiny animals, the vital roles they play in our ecosystems, and the reasons why our fragile relationship to them is in danger worldwide.

programme.title: Bugs That Rule the World 1 Episode 2
programme.desc: Learn how bees, butterflies, moths, and other pollinators keep our fields and forests fruitful, and weigh what life would be like if these busy bugs vanished. Witness a mysterious butterfly pilgrimage and a moth's clever way of escaping hungry bats.

programme.title: Bugs That Rule the World 1 Episode 3
programme.desc: Go up against predatory insects that are tailor-made for killing. See why the terrifying praying mantis has the agility of a martial artist and an appetite for everything from flies to hummingbirds, then go hunting in mid-air with deadly dragonflies.

programme.title: Bugs That Rule the World 1 Episode 4
programme.desc: Get a sanitation lesson from nature's original cleanup crew. Learn how beetles keep ecosystems in balance with clever biological weapons like tusks and toxic sprays, then see why the 6,000-plus species of dung beetles are the world's unsung heroes.

programme.title: Wild Dogs: Pack vs. Pride 2 Episode 3
programme.desc: Join Julz and park scout Simon Chulu as they track the Kakuli pack, who they filmed last year, and a Manzi faction who've ditched a tracking collar and broken away from the group. Spot the Kakumbi making a kill before a happy Manzi reunion ensues.

programme.title: Boss Shark
programme.desc: Witness the ultimate battle for dominance as scientists try to pick out the alpha male in a pack of 100-plus great white sharks off the New Zealand coast. Marvel at the speed, hunting prowess, and fearlessness that determine the leader of the pack.

programme.title: Boss Shark: Battle of the Sexes
programme.desc: Witness a shark competition unlike any other, where great whites go head-to-head in jaw-dropping tests of strength. Risk it all with shark specialist Dr. Riley Elliott as he tries to answer an age-old question: Which sex reigns supreme?

programme.desc: Explore community-run Reteti Elephant Sanctuary, where human surrogate moms offer survival lessons and nurture young elephants through play. Bond with trunkless Long'uro and see why six-year-old Kelele's mysterious illness could delay his release.

programme.title: Carpathian Predators 1
programme.desc: Join a mother brown bear as she struggles to find food for her two young cubs while teaching them essential skills for the harsh winter ahead. Then visit a pair of tiny lynx kittens as they begin to venture away from the safety of their den.

programme.title: Carpathian Predators 1 Episode 2
programme.desc: In the remote wilderness of the Carpathian Mountains lives an elusive predator that has inspired awe and fear throughout history: the Eurasian wolf. Discover the vital role that these once-misunderstood hunters play in protecting their ecosystem.

programme.title: Gangs of Lemur Island 1
programme.desc: As the dry season approaches, tensions rise on Lemur Island, both between rival gangs and within their own ranks. Get a view from the battlefield as the female leaders fiercely defend their turf, while their newborn infants cling to them for safety.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters 3 Episode 5
programme.desc: Enter the world of a wild dog pack whose bountiful hunting grounds are threatened when a clan of spotted hyenas moves in nearby. The vulnerable pups start to go hungry as the scavenging rivals steal their food and eventually raid their den.

programme.desc: Encounter an elephant as Julz and Henry from the ZCP track the Kakumbi pups, who face off with a stubborn, razor-tusked warthog. Follow Thandie Mweetwa, ZCP's lion specialist, who counts the prides that are pushing the Manzi out of their territory.

programme.title: Surviving the Amazon 1 Episode 5
programme.desc: Every year, more than 200,000 monkeys in Peru are trafficked illegally. Almost all are babies. Watch as these little ones learn to survive without their moms and try to make new friends along the way.

programme.title: Alaskan Summer
programme.desc: Nearly 20 hours of sunlight a day feed the season of abundance. Warmth unlocks water from the glaciers, ice caves and waterfalls. The water crashes into countless streams of the Inside Passage, feeding forest and wildlife alike. From June to August, Alaska becomes a paradise for it's wildlife.

programme.title: Gangs of Lemur Island 1 Episode 2
programme.desc: As food and water become scarce, Crystal, the fierce leader of the Ruins gang, sets her sights on rival Kati's territory and its neighboring fruit trees. Watch as Crystal's move and a raid by outside invaders lead to dire consequences for one troop.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters 3 Episode 6

programme.title: Brave Bang Bravern! Episode 6
programme.desc: Isami, Bravern, and Lewis drop down in Japan ahead of the others to search for survivors. Despite the bleak situation, Isami refuses to give up, and as if to respond to his unyielding resolve, a new power awakens within Bravern.

programme.title: KABANERI OF THE IRON FORTRESS
programme.desc: Kabane, the immortal monsters, attacked Aragane Station. Ikoma, a steam blacksmith boy who lives in Aragane Station, ran against the waves of terrified civilians. He is going to fight against Kabane using the weapon he has been secretly developing—the Piercing Gun. He fights for his own past and dignity.

programme.title: KABANERI OF THE IRON FORTRESS Episode 2
programme.desc: Ikoma somehow survives and heads towards the last Hayajiro left in Aragane Station, the Kotetsujyo. Meanwhile, Ayame and her people were left behind to fend off the Kabane when a young girl named Mumei appears before them. The girl clears open a path to the Kotetsujyo with incredible combat prowess.

programme.title: KABANERI OF THE IRON FORTRESS Episode 3
programme.desc: Having escaped Aragane Station, the Kotetsujyo heads for Kongokaku, the Shogunate's fortress. However, the people on the Kotetsujyo quickly turn against Ikoma and Mumei and attempt to drive them off the train. Having been thrown into her leadership position, Ayame lacks the power to subdue them...

programme.title: KABANERI OF THE IRON FORTRESS Episode 4
programme.desc: The other people lock Ikoma and Mumei into the rear car. But that means the Kotetsujyo has lost two of their best fighters. Just then, the Kabane attack. What's more, among them is a Wazatori, a Kabane that has the ability to learn and become stronger with each battle...

programme.title: KABANERI OF THE IRON FORTRESS Episode 5
programme.desc: The Kotetsujyo picks up survivors from Yashiro Station which has been destroyed by the Kabane. Among the survivors is Enoku, an old friend of Mumei's. He points out to Mumei how weak she'd become as he witnessed how close she's grown to the people of the Kotetsujyo. Rattled, Mumei chooses to throw herself into a reckless fight and finds herself in a dangerous situation.

programme.title: KABANERI OF THE IRON FORTRESS Episode 6
programme.desc: The Kotetsujyo is standing before a giant cluster of Kabane, the Black Smoke, and all seems hopeless. Meanwhile, Ikoma and Mumei find themselves at the bottom of an abandoned station. Surrounded by Kabane, Mumei buried under rubble, and no backup in sight, the situation is dire, yet Ikoma still somehow stands forward to face it.

programme.title: KABANERI OF THE IRON FORTRESS Episode 7
programme.desc: The Kotetsujyo arrives at Shitori Station, the first populated station it's encountered since leaving Aragane Station. Ikoma and the others leave to shop for some supplies, and experience their first moment of peace in ages. Meanwhile, Ayame negotiates with Shitori Station to see if they could spare some food, but food is precious everywhere...

programme.title: 少年歌行 / The Blood of Youth Episode 14
programme.desc:
改编自同名小说，本剧讲述了初出茅庐的少年侠客雷无桀，慕名前往江湖第一大城雪月城的途中误入雪落山庄，阴差阳错地卷入一场声势浩大的江湖之争，更牵扯出一段深藏多年的皇室秘辛。几个拥有离奇身世的少年侠客，一路相伴一路纠葛，在江湖道义、兄弟情谊、爱恨缠绵中，逐渐从懵懂无知进化成为了少年英雄，唱响了属于自己的侠义之歌。
Adapted from a novel, this period drama series tells the story of an inexperienced young pugilist who strays on his way to Xue Yue Town. Soon, he finds himself somehow getting involved in a massive fight in the pugilistic world, which ultimately led to the unveiling of an ancient royal secret that was kept hidden for years.

programme.title: 超级冰冰Show / Super Bing Bing Show Episode 80
programme.desc: 【超级冰冰 Show】是台湾综艺大姐大白冰冰新开的大型台语综艺歌唱节目，联同主持的还有阳帆及台一线。两小时的节目，将邀请观众喜爱的老中青歌手，演唱经典或流行的台语歌曲，让观众听出耳油来。想听好歌，就千万别错过！

programme.title: 型男大主厨 / Stylish Man Episode 938
programme.desc: 为庆祝新加坡建国60周年，【佳乐台】特别与台湾合作，让两对爱下厨的观众飞到台北与特别嘉宾黄靖伦及王振复组队，与型男大主厨们一起烹煮代表新加坡的特色菜肴，把新加坡的美食带给全世界。千万别错过这个在国庆日晚上首播，别具意义的【型男大主厨】新加坡特辑！To celebrate Singapore’s 60th birthday, Jia Le Channel flew 2 pairs of lucky viewers to the set of “Stylish Man” in Taipei to cook up dishes that represent Singapore! Pairing up with special guests Jing Wong and Jeff Wang, they will share the delicious cuisine from Singapore with the rest of the world. Don’t miss this special episode on the night of National Day!

programme.title: 麻雀乐团 / Heavenly Hand Episode 4
programme.desc: 大龙凤麻雀馆第二代传人司徒久，自少继承家业，见证湾仔的变迁。向来守旧的他，却突然斥资收购濒临解散的港湾乐团，令助手张铁反对不已。直到张铁得知司徒久此举是为了失散多年的女儿沈家明——乐团中的乐手，才愿出任副团长，协助父女相认。Szeto Jiu is a traditional man who inherited a mahjong parlour from his late father as a family business. When he discovers his long-lost daughter is a cellist in the struggling Metro Harbour Orchestra, he decides to invest in the near-disbanded ensemble, hoping this move will help mend past wounds and reconnect them.

programme.title: 超级夜总会 / Super Nightclub Episode 673
programme.desc: 台湾年度最新重金推出的户外歌唱综艺秀，它是耗资了千万打造的全台唯一行动舞台车，不只会全省走透透，还会邀请超级卡司，重现当年歌舞秀的热闹风光。听好歌，看好秀，就在由超级搭档——彭恰恰,许效舜所主持的〈超级夜总会〉，〈佳乐台〉抢先火速送上。

programme.title: 超級紅人榜 / Top Singers Episode 699
programme.desc: 难得一见、以台语歌曲为主的选秀节目即将登场！〈超级红人榜〉的宗旨是为了发扬台语歌曲，提供一个平台让对台语歌曲怀有热忱的各界人士发挥所长，发掘更多的演艺人才。这个节目自从开播以来屡创收视新高，通过知性风趣的于美人和选秀出生的蔡昌宪的轻松主持，您会惊讶地发现，原来台语歌曲不是年长人士的专有，原来年轻人唱起台语经典歌曲来也是很酷的！

programme.title: 追分成功 / Define Your Own Success Episode 75
programme.desc: 这是一部现代家庭伦理剧，看同住一屋簷下的单身房客，北漂追求梦想，在收获爱情、友情的同时，也面临得到与失去。他们向往完美爱情、渴望幸福婚姻、追求事业高升，不停向前“追分”，在这一路跌撞、相互陪伴的欢笑与泪水中，定义属于自己的“成功”！This drama series follows a group of single tenants under the same roof who travelled north to pursue their dreams, love and friendship. They yearn for perfect love, long for a happy marriage, and a good career advancement. Stumbling along the way with tears and laughter, they each define success by their own standards.

programme.title: 那些年，那些歌 / Memorable Classic Songs Episode 125
programme.desc:
全新音乐节目《那些年。那些歌》由音乐大师陈国华主持，邀请乐坛重量级歌王歌后，串连老、中、青三代音乐人，畅聊温馨感人的音乐故事，改编金典歌曲，用最动听的歌声，带领观众重温60、70年代的美好时光。
Memorable Classic Songs is a new music programs hosted by Chen Guo

programme.title: 上山吧，台湾队 / To The Top: Team Taiwan Episode 2
programme.desc: 本节目不仅是一场体能与意志的极限挑战，更是结合台湾专业与精神之旅。这项挑战历时两年筹备，由艺人连同台湾体坛顶尖运动员，在180天内登顶欧、亚、非大陆的三大圣山：从欧洲有“阿尔卑斯圣杯”之称的瑞士马特洪峰，到海拔5,895公尺的非洲第一高峰吉力马札罗山，最终回归台湾险峻壮丽的“圣棱线”七座百岳连峰。Taking 2 years to prepare for, this is an outdoor adventure series that is more than an ultimate test of physical strength and willpower. Led by artistes, top Taiwanese athletes took a tough journey to scale 3 mountains across the European, African and Asian continents – from Matterhorn in Switzerland to Mt Kilimanjaro in Africa to the Holy Ridge...

programme.title: 型男大主厨 / Stylish Man Episode 939
programme.desc: 台湾广受欢迎的常青美食料理节目，由2006年始播至今，2011年还获选金钟奖的最佳综合节目主持人奖。每一期将有不同的主题：“大明星來下廚”由兩位明星或两个明星档分組對抗，拿出自己的拿手菜對抗比拼；“五分钟出好菜”由两位厨师根据指定食材，在五分钟内烹煮出易学美味的一道菜等。这是一个富有娱乐效果的轻松美食节目，能够持续制作这么多年不是没有理由的。

programme.title: 超级冰冰Show / Super Bing Bing Show Episode 81
programme.desc: 【超级冰冰 Show】是台湾综艺大姐大白冰冰新开的大型台语综艺歌唱节目，联同主持的还有阳帆及台一线。两小时的节目，将邀请观众喜爱的老中青歌手，演唱经典或流行的台语歌曲，让观众听出耳油来。想听好歌，就千万别错过！

programme.title: 上山吧，台湾队 / To The Top: Team Taiwan Episode 3
programme.desc: 本节目不仅是一场体能与意志的极限挑战，更是结合台湾专业与精神之旅。这项挑战历时两年筹备，由艺人连同台湾体坛顶尖运动员，在180天内登顶欧、亚、非大陆的三大圣山：从欧洲有“阿尔卑斯圣杯”之称的瑞士马特洪峰，到海拔5,895公尺的非洲第一高峰吉力马札罗山，最终回归台湾险峻壮丽的“圣棱线”七座百岳连峰。Taking 2 years to prepare for, this is an outdoor adventure series that is more than an ultimate test of physical strength and willpower. Led by artistes, top Taiwanese athletes took a tough journey to scale 3 mountains across the European, African and Asian continents – from Matterhorn in Switzerland to Mt Kilimanjaro in Africa to the Holy Ridge...

programme.title: 型男大主厨 / Stylish Man Episode 939
programme.desc: 台湾广受欢迎的常青美食料理节目，由2006年始播至今，2011年还获选金钟奖的最佳综合节目主持人奖。每一期将有不同的主题：“大明星來下廚”由兩位明星或两个明星档分組對抗，拿出自己的拿手菜對抗比拼；“五分钟出好菜”由两位厨师根据指定食材，在五分钟内烹煮出易学美味的一道菜等。这是一个富有娱乐效果的轻松美食节目，能够持续制作这么多年不是没有理由的。

programme.title: 少年歌行 / The Blood of Youth Episode 14
programme.desc:
改编自同名小说，本剧讲述了初出茅庐的少年侠客雷无桀，慕名前往江湖第一大城雪月城的途中误入雪落山庄，阴差阳错地卷入一场声势浩大的江湖之争，更牵扯出一段深藏多年的皇室秘辛。几个拥有离奇身世的少年侠客，一路相伴一路纠葛，在江湖道义、兄弟情谊、爱恨缠绵中，逐渐从懵懂无知进化成为了少年英雄，唱响了属于自己的侠义之歌。
Adapted from a novel, this period drama series tells the story of an inexperienced young pugilist who strays on his way to Xue Yue Town. Soon, he finds himself somehow getting involved in a massive fight in the pugilistic world, which ultimately led to the unveiling of an ancient royal secret that was kept hidden for years.

programme.title: 那些年，那些歌 / Memorable Classic Songs Episode 125
programme.desc:

programme.desc: 大龙凤麻雀馆第二代传人司徒久，自少继承家业，见证湾仔的变迁。向来守旧的他，却突然斥资收购濒临解散的港湾乐团，令助手张铁反对不已。直到张铁得知司徒久此举是为了失散多年的女儿沈家明——乐团中的乐手，才愿出任副团长，协助父女相认。Szeto Jiu is a traditional man who inherited a mahjong parlour from his late father as a family business. programme.title: 爱的荣耀 / Glory of Love Episode 117
programme.desc: 一桩吸金诈骗案意外改变了三个女人的命运：有如大树般坚强的女性；如花般绽放的富家千金；也有如小草般的平凡女性。借由三个女主角来传达自信、勇气及自我价值的重要性，从爱出发能克服任何困境、挖掘出无限潜能和力量！A money-driven fraud case unexpectedly alters the destinies of three women: a resilient woman resembling a sturdy tree, a wealthy daughter blossoming like a flower, and an ordinary woman akin to grass. programme.title: 爱的荣耀 / Glory of Love Episode 118
programme.desc: 一桩吸金诈骗案意外改变了三个女人的命运：有如大树般坚强的女性；如花般绽放的富家千金；也有如小草般的平凡女性。借由三个女主角来传达自信、勇气及自我价值的重要性，从爱出发能克服任何困境、挖掘出无限潜能和力量！A money-driven fraud case unexpectedly alters the destinies of three women: a resilient woman resembling a sturdy tree, a wealthy daughter blossoming like a flower, and an ordinary woman akin to grass. programme.title: 整形过后 / Something Before and After Episode 2
programme.desc: 知名整形医师江浩宇与消失多年的学妹杨雅颂重逢，两人不同的理念与诊所利益冲突，让浩宇开始重新审视“美”背后的生命重量。韩国医师李侑恩的到来，更撼动了诊所的未来走向。随著每集个案的逐一揭开，整形不再只是修补外貌，而是触及人性裂缝与救赎的可能。Set in an elite plastic surgery clinic, renowned surgeon Yu reunites with long-lost classmate Song, sparking clashes over ethics and profit with opposing ideals. With a new Korean surgeon aboard, each case exposes the thin line between beauty, identity, and redemption.

programme.title: 不眠日 / Mobius Episode 3
programme.desc: 一场银行爆炸案打破华澳市的宁静，警官丁奇站在惨烈的爆炸现场却异常平静。因为他知晓这并非“最终结局”而是“循环日”，世界会随机进入连续五次的循环，零点零分回溯前一天，普通人无感，唯有他靠时间循环感知力屡破奇案。新循环一次次开启，离奇之处相继显现：生物集团多名高管接连死亡，伴随着神秘的乌贼杀人警告，意外频发……看似机械重复的日常下，阴谋渐显。丁奇更发现，自己并非唯一掌控“时间密钥”的人。当多名时间循环感知者搅动时空，第五个循环日的最终对决，将为你揭开所有谜团。In a specific time and space, detective Ding Qi accidentally discovered that he had the ability to reverse time and repeat the cycle five times on the same day from time to time. He used this superpower to solve many difficult cases. One day, a murder notice suddenly...

programme.title: 麻雀乐团 / Heavenly Hand Episode 5
programme.desc: 大龙凤麻雀馆第二代传人司徒久，自少继承家业，见证湾仔的变迁。向来守旧的他，却突然斥资收购濒临解散的港湾乐团，令助手张铁反对不已。直到张铁得知司徒久此举是为了失散多年的女儿沈家明——乐团中的乐手，才愿出任副团长，协助父女相认。Szeto Jiu is a traditional man who inherited a mahjong parlour from his late father as a family business. When he discovers his long-lost daughter is a cellist in the struggling Metro Harbour Orchestra, he decides to invest in the near-disbanded ensemble, hoping this move will help mend past wounds and reconnect them.

programme.title: 少年歌行 / The Blood of Youth Episode 15
programme.desc:
改编自同名小说，本剧讲述了初出茅庐的少年侠客雷无桀，慕名前往江湖第一大城雪月城的途中误入雪落山庄，阴差阳错地卷入一场声势浩大的江湖之争，更牵扯出一段深藏多年的皇室秘辛。几个拥有离奇身世的少年侠客，一路相伴一路纠葛，在江湖道义、兄弟情谊、爱恨缠绵中，逐渐从懵懂无知进化成为了少年英雄，唱响了属于自己的侠义之歌。
Adapted from a novel, this period drama series tells the story of an inexperienced young pugilist who strays on his way to Xue Yue Town. Soon, he finds himself somehow getting involved in a massive fight in the pugilistic world, which ultimately led to the unveiling of an ancient royal secret that was kept hidden for years.

programme.desc: 周胜强、陈进辉与方耀武是共赴东南亚发展的结拜兄弟。某天三人冒险从事走私活动，却因为鬼王使其关系产生变化。鬼王为了夺回钻石，追杀周胜强等人，后因方耀武为了自保，导致替周胜强挡下子弹的陈进辉跌下山崖失忆。之后陈进辉被鬼王的女儿明娜救起后到日本发展，并改名青木洋介。陈进辉失踪后，妻子江碧玉与长子陈子维因走投无路而被高世贤救下，而后发现怀上遗腹女陈晓春。。。28 years ago, three sworn brothers Qiang, Hui and Wu prayed earnestly in the temple for their diamond smuggling deal in Myanmar to succeed. When they arrived in the Myanmar mountains however, they were betrayed by the Ghost King who decided to kill them instead. Hui shielded Qiang from bullets but fell off from the clif...

programme.title: 整形过后 / Something Before and After Episode 3
programme.desc: 知名整形医师江浩宇与消失多年的学妹杨雅颂重逢，两人不同的理念与诊所利益冲突，让浩宇开始重新审视“美”背后的生命重量。韩国医师李侑恩的到来，更撼动了诊所的未来走向。随著每集个案的逐一揭开，整形不再只是修补外貌，而是触及人性裂缝与救赎的可能。Set in an elite plastic surgery clinic, renowned surgeon Yu reunites with long-lost classmate Song, sparking clashes over ethics and profit with opposing ideals. With a new Korean surgeon aboard, each case exposes the thin line between beauty, identity, and redemption.

programme.title: 不眠日 / Mobius Episode 4
programme.desc: 一场银行爆炸案打破华澳市的宁静，警官丁奇站在惨烈的爆炸现场却异常平静。因为他知晓这并非“最终结局”而是“循环日”，世界会随机进入连续五次的循环，零点零分回溯前一天，普通人无感，唯有他靠时间循环感知力屡破奇案。新循环一次次开启，离奇之处相继显现：生物集团多名高管接连死亡，伴随着神秘的乌贼杀人警告，意外频发……看似机械重复的日常下，阴谋渐显。丁奇更发现，自己并非唯一掌控“时间密钥”的人。当多名时间循环感知者搅动时空，第五个循环日的最终对决，将为你揭开所有谜团。In a specific time and space, detective Ding Qi accidentally discovered that he had the ability to reverse time and repeat the cycle five times on the same day from time to time. He used this superpower to solve many difficult cases. One day, a murder notice suddenly...

programme.title: 麻雀乐团 / Heavenly Hand Episode 6
programme.desc: 大龙凤麻雀馆第二代传人司徒久，自少继承家业，见证湾仔的变迁。向来守旧的他，却突然斥资收购濒临解散的港湾乐团，令助手张铁反对不已。直到张铁得知司徒久此举是为了失散多年的女儿沈家明——乐团中的乐手，才愿出任副团长，协助父女相认。Szeto Jiu is a traditional man who inherited a mahjong parlour from his late father as a family business. When he discovers his long-lost daughter is a cellist in the struggling Metro Harbour Orchestra, he decides to invest in the near-disbanded ensemble, hoping this move will help mend past wounds and reconnect them.

programme.title: 少年歌行 / The Blood of Youth Episode 16
programme.desc:
改编自同名小说，本剧讲述了初出茅庐的少年侠客雷无桀，慕名前往江湖第一大城雪月城的途中误入雪落山庄，阴差阳错地卷入一场声势浩大的江湖之争，更牵扯出一段深藏多年的皇室秘辛。几个拥有离奇身世的少年侠客，一路相伴一路纠葛，在江湖道义、兄弟情谊、爱恨缠绵中，逐渐从懵懂无知进化成为了少年英雄，唱响了属于自己的侠义之歌。

programme.title: 爱的荣耀 / Glory of Love Episode 119
programme.desc: 一桩吸金诈骗案意外改变了三个女人的命运：有如大树般坚强的女性；如花般绽放的富家千金；也有如小草般的平凡女性。借由三个女主角来传达自信、勇气及自我价值的重要性，从爱出发能克服任何困境、挖掘出无限潜能和力量！A money-driven fraud case unexpectedly alters the destinies of three women: a resilient woman resembling a sturdy tree, a wealthy daughter blossoming like a flower, and an ordinary woman akin to grass. When he discovers his long-lost daughter is a cellist in the struggling Metro Harbour Orchestra, he decides to invest in the near-disbanded ensemble, hoping this move will help mend past wounds and reconnect them.

programme.title: 少年歌行 / The Blood of Youth Episode 17
programme.desc:
改编自同名小说，本剧讲述了初出茅庐的少年侠客雷无桀，慕名前往江湖第一大城雪月城的途中误入雪落山庄，阴差阳错地卷入一场声势浩大的江湖之争，更牵扯出一段深藏多年的皇室秘辛。几个拥有离奇身世的少年侠客，一路相伴一路纠葛，在江湖道义、兄弟情谊、爱恨缠绵中，逐渐从懵懂无知进化成为了少年英雄，唱响了属于自己的侠义之歌。
Adapted from a novel, this period drama series tells the story of an inexperienced young pugilist who strays on his way to Xue Yue Town. Soon, he finds himself somehow getting involved in a massive fight in the pugilistic world, which ultimately led to the unveiling of an ancient royal secret that was kept hidden for years.

programme.title: 不眠日 / Mobius Episode 5
programme.desc: 一场银行爆炸案打破华澳市的宁静，警官丁奇站在惨烈的爆炸现场却异常平静。因为他知晓这并非“最终结局”而是“循环日”，世界会随机进入连续五次的循环，零点零分回溯前一天，普通人无感，唯有他靠时间循环感知力屡破奇案。新循环一次次开启，离奇之处相继显现：生物集团多名高管接连死亡，伴随着神秘的乌贼杀人警告，意外频发……看似机械重复的日常下，阴谋渐显。丁奇更发现，自己并非唯一掌控“时间密钥”的人。当多名时间循环感知者搅动时空，第五个循环日的最终对决，将为你揭开所有谜团。In a specific time and space, detective Ding Qi accidentally discovered that he had the ability to reverse time and repeat the cycle five times on the same day from time to time. He used this superpower to solve many difficult cases. One day, a murder notice suddenly...

programme.title: 整形过后 / Something Before and After Episode 4
programme.desc: 知名整形医师江浩宇与消失多年的学妹杨雅颂重逢，两人不同的理念与诊所利益冲突，让浩宇开始重新审视“美”背后的生命重量。韩国医师李侑恩的到来，更撼动了诊所的未来走向。随著每集个案的逐一揭开，整形不再只是修补外貌，而是触及人性裂缝与救赎的可能。Set in an elite plastic surgery clinic, renowned surgeon Yu reunites with long-lost classmate Song, sparking clashes over ethics and profit with opposing ideals. With a new Korean surgeon aboard, each case exposes the thin line between beauty, identity, and redemption.

programme.title: 爱的荣耀 / Glory of Love Episode 120
programme.desc: 一桩吸金诈骗案意外改变了三个女人的命运：有如大树般坚强的女性；如花般绽放的富家千金；也有如小草般的平凡女性。借由三个女主角来传达自信、勇气及自我价值的重要性，从爱出发能克服任何困境、挖掘出无限潜能和力量！A money-driven fraud case unexpectedly alters the destinies of three women: a resilient woman resembling a sturdy tree, a wealthy daughter blossoming like a flower, and an ordinary woman akin to grass. 改编自同名小说，本剧讲述了初出茅庐的少年侠客雷无桀，慕名前往江湖第一大城雪月城的途中误入雪落山庄，阴差阳错地卷入一场声势浩大的江湖之争，更牵扯出一段深藏多年的皇室秘辛。几个拥有离奇身世的少年侠客，一路相伴一路纠葛，在江湖道义、兄弟情谊、爱恨缠绵中，逐渐从懵懂无知进化成为了少年英雄，唱响了属于自己的侠义之歌。
Adapted from a novel, this period drama series tells the story of an inexperienced young pugilist who strays on his way to Xue Yue Town. Soon, he finds himself somehow getting involved in a massive fight in the pugilistic world, which ultimately led to the unveiling of an ancient royal secret that was kept hidden for years.

programme.title: 不眠日 / Mobius Episode 6
programme.desc: 一场银行爆炸案打破华澳市的宁静，警官丁奇站在惨烈的爆炸现场却异常平静。因为他知晓这并非“最终结局”而是“循环日”，世界会随机进入连续五次的循环，零点零分回溯前一天，普通人无感，唯有他靠时间循环感知力屡破奇案。新循环一次次开启，离奇之处相继显现：生物集团多名高管接连死亡，伴随着神秘的乌贼杀人警告，意外频发……看似机械重复的日常下，阴谋渐显。丁奇更发现，自己并非唯一掌控“时间密钥”的人。当多名时间循环感知者搅动时空，第五个循环日的最终对决，将为你揭开所有谜团。In a specific time and space, detective Ding Qi accidentally discovered that he had the ability to reverse time and repeat the cycle five times on the same day from time to time. He used this superpower to solve many difficult cases. One day, a murder notice suddenly...

programme.title: 麻雀乐团 / Heavenly Hand Episode 8
programme.desc: 大龙凤麻雀馆第二代传人司徒久，自少继承家业，见证湾仔的变迁。向来守旧的他，却突然斥资收购濒临解散的港湾乐团，令助手张铁反对不已。直到张铁得知司徒久此举是为了失散多年的女儿沈家明——乐团中的乐手，才愿出任副团长，协助父女相认。Szeto Jiu is a traditional man who inherited a mahjong parlour from his late father as a family business. When he discovers his long-lost daughter is a cellist in the struggling Metro Harbour Orchestra, he decides to invest in the near-disbanded ensemble, hoping this move will help mend past wounds and reconnect them.

programme.title: 整形过后 / Something Before and After Episode 5
programme.desc: 知名整形医师江浩宇与消失多年的学妹杨雅颂重逢，两人不同的理念与诊所利益冲突，让浩宇开始重新审视“美”背后的生命重量。韩国医师李侑恩的到来，更撼动了诊所的未来走向。随著每集个案的逐一揭开，整形不再只是修补外貌，而是触及人性裂缝与救赎的可能。Set in an elite plastic surgery clinic, renowned surgeon Yu reunites with long-lost classmate Song, sparking clashes over ethics and profit with opposing ideals. With a new Korean surgeon aboard, each case exposes the thin line between beauty, identity, and redemption.

programme.title: 爱的荣耀 / Glory of Love Episode 121
programme.desc: 一桩吸金诈骗案意外改变了三个女人的命运：有如大树般坚强的女性；如花般绽放的富家千金；也有如小草般的平凡女性。借由三个女主角来传达自信、勇气及自我价值的重要性，从爱出发能克服任何困境、挖掘出无限潜能和力量！A money-driven fraud case unexpectedly alters the destinies of three women: a resilient woman resembling a sturdy tree, a wealthy daughter blossoming like a flower, and an ordinary woman akin to grass. Memorable Classic Songs is a new music programs hosted by Chen Guo

programme.title: 镜行曲 / Mirror Walker Episode 6
programme.desc: 节目以“城市味道、人情故事”为主轴，走访台湾各地，深入巷弄、街头、老店，挖掘最具代表性的在地小吃与背后的故事。后13集的节目则走访台湾各个角落的火车站，带观众探索人烟稀少的古朴小站及周边的人文风景，展现台湾的温度与深度。A lifestyle series that focuses on the culinary soul of Taiwan’s cities, exploring how local snacks reflect the culture, history, and daily lives of the people. From bustling night markets to hidden alleyway eateries, the series offers a warm, authentic look at Taiwan’s urban flavours and the people who preserve them. programme.title: 流水迢迢 / Love of Nirvana Episode 34
programme.desc: 月落城少城主萧无瑕，忍辱负重潜伏梁国多年，化名为卫昭，背负佞臣骂名。卫昭为查清当年家族真相，试图掳走齐王桉的唯一活口，但自己精心布置的计划却被突然出现的少女江慈所破坏。裴琰趁机将重伤的江慈养入府中，以求找到幕后“破坏者”。而卫昭的悲惨身世和民族大义也触动了天真烂漫的江慈，二人在相处中看到了彼此的闪光点，互生情愫。最终，卫昭、江慈、裴琰三人放下私人恩怨，共同对抗梁帝谢澈，实现了守护月落，建立清明天下的愿望。 Xiao Wuxia, the young lord of Moonfall City, endures humiliation and infiltrates the Liang Kingdom for many years, disguising himself as Wei Zhao and carrying the stigma of betrayal. To uncover the truth behind his family's murder, Wei Zhao attempts to abduct the only living witness from th...

programme.title: 我们的翻译官 / The Interpreter Episode 25
programme.desc: 翻译界女神林西重逢前任男友肖一成。八年前，林西为完成母亲未完成的梦想，忍痛和肖一成分手。八年后，林西已是华声最年轻的首席口译专家，而肖一成是语译的首席技术官。为拿下合同，林西不得不与肖一成“周旋”，两人的感情重新被点燃。肖一成渐渐理解了当时林西与自己分手的真相，也看到了她为接近梦想的努力，于是选择成为她追求梦想路上的坚强后盾。

programme.title: 奔跑吧.天路篇 / Keep Running Special Season 6
programme.desc: 《奔跑吧特别季2025》着重于中国一些偏远和少为人知的地点城市，通过创新游戏设置，增加艺人与当地民众的互动，同时激发大众对奔跑的渴望、对温暖的传递和对美好的追求，以综艺化的特色表达传递正能量。节目还是由“奔跑吧”固定MC班底 - 超人气大卡艺人继续担纲主持任务。Keep Running” is a spin-off from the hugely popular Korean variety “Running Man”. The reality game show sees popular China artistes compete to complete missions at various landmarks to win the race for each episode. The series returns this year for a sixth Special season focusing on locations in the lesser-known rural areas in China.

programme.title: 清明上河图密码 / Riverside Code at Qingming Festival Episode 5
programme.desc: 北宋宣和年间，汴梁城雀儿巷一角生活着赵不尤、温悦等性格迥异的一家五口人。赵不尤本是大理寺最底层的贴书小吏，只想过平凡的烟火日子，妻子温悦却一心只想置宅购田。一家人时常吵吵闹闹却也其乐融融。一次意外，一家人被卷入轰动的梅船大案中，随着一桩桩案件破解，一家人各显其能开启了一边破解案件、一边解决层出不穷的家庭问题和各自成长的奇妙之旅。最终一家五口重新认识并接纳了彼此，也各自收获了成长，携手揭露了幕后黑手的伪善与恶行，既捍卫了小家的幸福，也守护了汴梁百姓的安乐。

programme.title: 玫瑰的故事 / The Tale of Rose Episode 35
programme.desc: 出生于书香世家的黄亦玫一路在呵护中长大，从小便展露出艺术天赋。初入职场的黄亦玫很快受到重用，与合作伙伴庄国栋相识相爱，但最终错过彼此，这段职场磨炼也令她对自己的人生有了更清晰的规划，决定重返校园求学深造。毕业后，她和学长方协文步入婚姻殿堂。可婚后两人发展方向相去甚远，最 终选择离婚。黄亦玫开始创业，在艺术品策展领域打拼出一片天地，在此期间还遇到了自己的灵魂伴侣溥家明，可溥家明只剩几个月的生命，两人这段爱情最终以生死离别画上句号。 但黄亦玫没有就此消沉，她还是一如既往地为活出更精彩的自己而努力着。

programme.title: 玫瑰的故事 / The Tale of Rose Episode 35
programme.desc: 出生于书香世家的黄亦玫一路在呵护中长大，从小便展露出艺术天赋。初入职场的黄亦玫很快受到重用，与合作伙伴庄国栋相识相爱，但最终错过彼此，这段职场磨炼也令她对自己的人生有了更清晰的规划，决定重返校园求学深造。毕业后，她和学长方协文步入婚姻殿堂。可婚后两人发展方向相去甚远，最 终选择离婚。黄亦玫开始创业，在艺术品策展领域打拼出一片天地，在此期间还遇到了自己的灵魂伴侣溥家明，可溥家明只剩几个月的生命，两人这段爱情最终以生死离别画上句号。 但黄亦玫没有就此消沉，她还是一如既往地为活出更精彩的自己而努力着。

programme.title: 花轿喜事 / Wrong Carriage Right Groom
programme.desc: 这天在扬州城有两个小姐同时出嫁了，一个是城中富商的小姐杜冰雁，一个是城中武师的女儿李玉湖。两位小姐都有着外人看似美满的姻缘，冰雁将嫁给柳州巨商齐府的三公子齐天磊，而玉湖将嫁给当朝的重臣袁不屈大将军，但其中的苦水只有她们自己知道。齐天磊体弱多病，为了冲喜才赶着完成婚事；而袁不屈之前在李家受尽白眼，为了报复才决意要娶玉湖。正当两位小姐在花轿上暗自垂泪的时候，突然下起了滂沱大雨。两队娶亲的队伍同时躲到了同一座庙里躲雨，岂料雨过天晴后轿夫竟然抬错了花轿，于是两段离奇曲折的姻缘开始了 。

programme.title: 花轿喜事 / Wrong Carriage Right Groom
programme.desc: 这天在扬州城有两个小姐同时出嫁了，一个是城中富商的小姐杜冰雁，一个是城中武师的女儿李玉湖。两位小姐都有着外人看似美满的姻缘，冰雁将嫁给柳州巨商齐府的三公子齐天磊，而玉湖将嫁给当朝的重臣袁不屈大将军，但其中的苦水只有她们自己知道。齐天磊体弱多病，为了冲喜才赶着完成婚事；而袁不屈之前在李家受尽白眼，为了报复才决意要娶玉湖。正当两位小姐在花轿上暗自垂泪的时候，突然下起了滂沱大雨。两队娶亲的队伍同时躲到了同一座庙里躲雨，岂料雨过天晴后轿夫竟然抬错了花轿，于是两段离奇曲折的姻缘开始了 。

programme.title: 玫瑰的故事 / The Tale of Rose Episode 37
programme.desc: 出生于书香世家的黄亦玫一路在呵护中长大，从小便展露出艺术天赋。初入职场的黄亦玫很快受到重用，与合作伙伴庄国栋相识相爱，但最终错过彼此，这段职场磨炼也令她对自己的人生有了更清晰的规划，决定重返校园求学深造。毕业后，她和学长方协文步入婚姻殿堂。可婚后两人发展方向相去甚远，最 终选择离婚。黄亦玫开始创业，在艺术品策展领域打拼出一片天地，在此期间还遇到了自己的灵魂伴侣溥家明，可溥家明只剩几个月的生命，两人这段爱情最终以生死离别画上句号。 但黄亦玫没有就此消沉，她还是一如既往地为活出更精彩的自己而努力着。

programme.title: 我们的翻译官 / The Interpreter Episode 31
programme.desc: 翻译界女神林西重逢前任男友肖一成。八年前，林西为完成母亲未完成的梦想，忍痛和肖一成分手。八年后，林西已是华声最年轻的首席口译专家，而肖一成是语译的首席技术官。为拿下合同，林西不得不与肖一成“周旋”，两人的感情重新被点燃。肖一成渐渐理解了当时林西与自己分手的真相，也看到了她为接近梦想的努力，于是选择成为她追求梦想路上的坚强后盾。

programme.desc: 著名芭蕾舞艺术家谭思婷盛名之下退役归国，与曾经的恋人冯睿意外重逢，经历重重波折后最终破镜重圆的故事。多年前两人因误会遗憾分手，简单真挚的校园恋爱无疾而终。久别重逢后两颗平静的心再次泛起涟漪，压抑不住对彼此的思念。而冯睿被谭思婷对芭蕾梦想的执着追求与热爱，以及对自己始终如一的情感所打动，最终冯睿放下心结勇敢追爱，有情人终成眷属，谭思婷的芭蕾事业也得以薪火相传。Ballet dancer Tan Siting retired and returned to China to teach, dedicating herself to nurturing new talent. She met a young dancer, Zheng Yufan, who was struggling, and devoted all her knowledge to help her win gold at an international competition. Tan Siting’s spirit of pursuing her dreams earned widespread acclai...

programme.title: 雁回时 / The Glory
programme.desc: 庄寒雁从小被弃养至南方乡下，辗转重回京城庄家，引起了大理寺少卿傅云夕的注意。傅云夕身患奇症，意图求娶一位德才兼备的妻子以托付亲朋，胆识过人而又心地善良的庄寒雁成为他的最佳人选。庄寒雁和傅云夕在互相试探周旋的过程中爱上彼此，寒雁也与母亲和解，找回了失落的亲情，并在与傅家人的相处中感受到家庭的温暖和亲情的美好。庄寒雁和傅云夕二人联合揭穿了庄家家长庄仕洋在伪善的面具下弄权枉法的罪恶行径，成为恩爱眷侣。Zhuang Hanyan, abandoned and raised in the southern countryside since childhood, returns to the Zhuang family in the capital, attracting the attention of Fu Yunxi. programme.title: Battle ATM
programme.desc: 极具未来感场景的全新益智综艺节目《拜托ATM》，结合电玩游戏概念，挑战者将透过益智竞争，开启ATM进行终极译码游戏。一场科技与智慧的益智竞赛《拜托ATM》由行长胡瓜、襄理Sandra与精英挑战者携手打造。

programme.title: 上山下海过一夜 / Have a nice dream
programme.desc: 由五位懂得户外生活的玩家，计划好一趟上山下海两天一夜的行程，在旅途中与观众分享台湾最棒的山林旅游秘境，既上山、又下海享受大自然生活的浪漫与乐趣，并在充满奥妙的自然生态旅途中，告诉大家如何好好保护台湾这片有令人赞叹的风景及最蔚蓝的海域…

programme.title: 兄弟帮 / Big Boys Club Episode 250
programme.desc: 《兄弟帮》是由一班「好兄弟」林盛斌、梁竞徽、王梓轩、范振锋及陈国峰主持的年青人清谈节目，每集邀请歌手、艺人或不同界别人士作嘉宾，进行轻松访谈，带来时下社会热话、流行文化、潮流玩意等多元化内容。有关爱情、两性，以致同性关系，是男男女女谈之不尽的话题，节目邀来不同界别的嘉宾「谈情说爱」，探讨两性相处之道。「异度空间」专题，请来嘉宾分享不思议事件，如见鬼、UFO、奇人奇事等刺激话题。

programme.title: 宠爱Pet Pet / My Pet My Angel Episode 16
programme.desc: 第19集 敏莉报称小泡芙身上的钻石吊饰不见了，最终在惠婷的诊症室找到，并报警控告惠婷与声仁盗窃。惠婷、声仁得悉审理案件的法官正是邻居杨盛昌，二人想起曾因盛昌养的鹦鹉方丈而得罪过他，深感不妙。同时，定风不计前嫌担任二人的辩护律师。冬甩坚决要去法庭找盛昌说明真相，在一众动物好友掩护下来到法院外，蓄势待发……定风得出辩论新方向，提出让冬甩出庭却被盛昌拒绝。晚上，声仁、惠婷代方丈向盛昌传话……

programme.title: 守诚者 & 今日知多D / Homeland Guardian & What's On Today Episode 21
programme.desc: 第24集 全港警民全力守城 何浩辉带警员去找周雄，路上给邵峰打电话汇报情况。全球金融峰会现场的刘先生得知炸弹之事，告诉阮sir港府绝无可能向周雄妥协，阮sir表示已经安排警力，守备在会场的部分警力也调动过去，刘先生指示一定要在股市开市前拆除炸弹。陈耀扬让骆雅琪一定要在股市开市前抓到安娜，阻止他们的计划。 蔡卓欣被周雄手下带到了假三号车上。骆雅琪等警员通过断电的手段确定了安娜及其手下所在的房间，周雄和安娜通电话，两人信心满满在股市开市时启动金融核弹。此时正在放假的棠哥，在街上看到了假三号车，急忙打的士尾随这辆假三号车，给梁婉婷打电话知道三号车并没有修好。何浩辉得知周雄到了历新大厦，迅速驱车赶往，此时的周雄正在大厦的天台上远眺会展中心。假三号车进了会展中心地下车库，棠哥所坐的士被值守的警员截停，他无法进入地下车库，给梁婉婷打电话求助，梁婉婷和谢庭威带棠哥进入地下车库。

programme.title: 爱．回家之开心速递 / Lo And Behold Episode 1721
programme.desc: 熊树根(刘丹)由基层做起，他时常牵挂的只有三位宝贝女儿，大女早已移民海外、二女熊若水(吕慧仪)已届适婚年龄却嫁杏无期，经常与优异生妹妹熊心如(苏韵姿)为琐碎事争吵不休，令老爸哭笑不得。

programme.title: 东张西望 / Scoop 2026 Episode 16
programme.desc: 《东张西望》星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事、趣闻逸事，并报导娱乐圈最新动态、艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮。「今日突发」环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事、社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家。

programme.title: 最强生命线 / Vital Lifeline Episode 272
programme.desc: 都市人生活节奏紧张，压力又大，身体易出毛病，《最强生命线》为你解构健康之道。首先一连四集介绍都市痛症系列，分别是头痛，肩颈痛，背痛，关节痛。每集都会邀请医学专家讲解各种疾病的成因，还有物理治疗师，运动治疗师教做适当的运动。现在流行中西医结合，美国游泳健将菲比斯都用拔罐来纾缓疼痛，所以每集都会有中医断症，辅以针灸，拔罐和三伏天最适合做的天灸等治疗方法，另外，中医还教我们煲滋补的汤水，都可以调理身体。

programme.title: 骊歌行 / Court Lady Episode 97
programme.desc: 太平盛世，百姓安居乐业，一片祥和。大将军盛骁靖之子盛楚慕(许凯饰)从小被母亲宠溺，是长安城里有名的纨绔子弟。一次广州府远游，盛楚慕偶遇绣坊商户家的小姐傅柔(李一桐饰)，对其一见倾心，装作文武双全的有识之士，誓要抱得美人归。几次接触之后，傅柔察觉到盛楚慕实则不学无术，对他失望不已。盛楚慕决心为了爱情而改变自己，学习兵法武艺，终于赢得了傅柔的青睐。确定心意的二人回到长安，傅柔阴差阳错进宫成为女官，盛楚慕也被迫加入军队。二人为了爱情而接受考验，也在这一成长过程中看清了自己肩上的责任，携手拯救家国危机，为国家的繁

programme.title: 流行都市 / Big City Shop 2026 Episode 13
programme.desc: 《流行都市》为观众介绍时令产品、健康养生、健体运动、护肤化妆、时尚服饰、婴幼儿护理、育儿知识、城中美食、饲养宠物等潮流信息，内容包罗万有！主持们亲身体验、示范或测试之外，还会邀请嘉宾带来相关专业知识。烹饪环节方面，多位手势了得的厨艺专家轮流登场，示范简单美味的健康美食、家常小菜，替大家解决煮食烦恼。

programme.title: 快乐长门人 / Happy Old Buddies Episode 253
programme.desc: 不少人或会认为长者并没有性需要，但有调查发现结果却非如此，长者只是因为不同原因引致性生活有所减少。社署临床心理学家林晧明详述世卫对性的定义，并替想跟老伴重启性生活的老友记带来建议。不过，另一半如不想恢复性行为，双方应如何沟通？

programme.title: 感动味蕾美食餐厅100强 - 关西篇 / Tastebuds Pamper Top 100 Delicacy Restro Episode 9
programme.desc:
第9集 微笑 感动味蕾 日本部份餐厅因担心其他客人受到骚扰，而不招待小朋友。有寿司店料理人却欢迎孩子光顾，还提供炸制的青眼鱼米粉卷等食品，符合儿童口味。
手工啤酒厂聘用残障人士工作，在这友善、快乐的环境下，出品亦更滋味，其柚子啤酒掳获主持们欢心。
师傅透过天妇罗，呈现他对食物的热爱。把雪蟹连壳下锅炸香，还有炸出游泳姿态的小香鱼，都是其创意之作。
另外，店主希望透过美味的甜品，为顾客打气。店内的向日葵造型芭菲，未吃已令人感开心。

programme.title: Hands Up / Hands Up 2026 Episode 6
programme.desc:
全新儿童节目《Hands Up》鼓励小朋友勇于发问，表达自我，向目标进发！
吉祥物「酱汁家族」成员跟一众主持演出短剧，陪伴大家度过愉快时光。另会带来多首儿歌，让孩子们边唱边学习生活知识。
小朋友走进录像厂，寓学习于娱乐。透过不同主题游戏，加强逻辑思维、锻练体能；玩转STEAM实验，脑力全开！
节目特设表演小舞台，让小朋友展示才艺；齐集创意工作室，DIY小手工。小教「煮」环节，家长和子女共享亲子烹饪乐趣。

programme.title: 白色强人II / Big White Duel II Episode 15
programme.desc: 第15集 唐明强忍悲痛为苏怡开刀，脑海想起两人初相识的点滴。经历一夜忙碌，文信将明成北的医疗发展比喻和救人一样，叶晴三思药研中心的方向。苏怡手术后，唐明一直没进病房替她检查。霭宁赶回港跑到苏怡病床前，强忍一整天的担心情绪终于爆发。内地富商郭昭带同患脑癫痫儿子到明成北求医，并要求文信、叶晴低调处理。苏怡从叶晴口中得知唐明没离开过医院，主动致电唐明。苏怡当面劝唐明好好回家休息，更向他道出当年离婚的真正原因……

programme.title: 白色强人II / Big White Duel II Episode 16
programme.desc: 第16集 叶晴看准郭昭之子东东在明成北开脑的机会，另有想法。叶晴于手术前递上计划书，惟郭昭向来爱赚快钱，拒绝叶晴邀请。东东手术途中突然被铭章叫停，不知就里的逸滔向铭章直言只会等待十分钟。郭昭看到手术暂停很是担心，很快便明白叶晴的意图……东东手术后，逸滔终得悉叶晴背后动作，二人势不两立。一名十六岁少女等候换肺，唐明本想替少女进行活肺移植，其大哥却担心手术风险高，唐明束手无策。晚上，少女病情恶化，命悬一线……

programme.title: 还原神之食 / Food Mister
programme.desc:
第2集 极品肝酱烤鸭
要接近还原《美味天王》中一道「肝酱烤鸭」，必先掌握肥肝的秘密。积奇准备了多款肥肝产品，欣茵、泳芍蒙眼试食，能否尝出当中等级之别？
将原个鸭肝制成鸭肝酱，需要经过「拆线」、腌味、炖焗、冷藏等多重步骤，花足三天才可完成。成品「拆封」，急不及待要试味，有主持却以「笨之手」浪费了积奇部份心血？
「魔幻三重奏」是西餐味道基调，炒香后混合原鸭肝酱、非洲小米等一同塞进鸭内，再入炉烤焗，馅料吸尽肉汁香味，极其滋味！

programme.title: HOME即是识 / Funny Funny Home Episode 15
programme.desc: 家家户户，总是会发生大大小小不同的家居难题。为了一家人生活美满，家庭各个成员均会竭尽所能，希望解决问题。正因如此，可能是天花板发霉，又或是渠道淤塞等家居问题，大家都曾处理过，也练就出一身化解屋中疑难杂症的好本领。有见及此，《HOME即是识》征召一众对家事博学多才的朋友参赛，比拼生活智慧，胜出者更可获得丰富的奖金奖品。屏幕前的观众透过节目亦可增长家居知识，令居家生活更加美好。

programme.title: 周六聊Teen谷 / ChatSAT Episode 2
programme.desc: 会用尽所能搜罗世界各地至潮、至新情报，上至世界盛事、医学百科、文艺与科技；下至日常生活、网络热搜，在每个星期六跟观众一一分享。论尽天南地北，畅谈人气热话，「谷友」紧贴节目，便可轻松掌握全球脉搏动向。

programme.title: 中年好声音4 / Midlife, Sing & Shine! 4
programme.desc: 《中年好声音4》宣布启航，延续前三季的成功，再次为歌唱爱好者筑建逐梦舞台。本季更将招募版图扩展至北美、澳洲等地，还有TVB多位艺员「蒙面」出战，让音乐之火燃遍全球，照亮无数追梦者的心弦。车婉婉继续主持大局，以温暖笑容陪伴一众选手；肥妈、周国丰、张佳添、海儿、谷娅溦亦坐镇评审席，为参赛者提供专业点评与鼓励。在新一季的舞台上，大家将以音乐交织出更动人的篇章，续写属于《中年好声音》的真摰故事。

programme.title: 华润集团呈献:无穷之路V-智行无疆 / China Resources (Holdings) Co. Ltd. Presents: No Poverty Land V - Odyssey of Intelligence Episode 6
programme.desc: 2025年，《无穷之路》来到第五辑，制作队深入中国科技最前线，带大家见证全国上下如何由「制造」走向「智造」。一代代科技人的背后，又有甚么梦想和坚持？这一辑透过这些科技突破背后的「人的故事」，展现科研工作者如何用智慧与坚持，推动中国由「制造大国」迈向「智造强国」的转型历程。

programme.desc: 随着女性经济力量攀升，针对女性群的吃喝玩乐体验应运而生。麦玲玲先与何依婷、林凯恩、何沛珈、刘晓昆结伴同游上海，再会合吴若希、戴祖仪、游嘉欣玩转深圳、广州，以女性角度带大家「寻欢作乐」，见识时下备受姊妹们追捧的潮流文化与玩意，探索网红打卡美食和景点，迎接多个「第一次」！「姐姐们」组团北上尝鲜，猛男烤肉、帅哥居酒屋、小鲜肉按摩店、硬核健身、一对一辣身舞、格斗酒吧等非凡体验，如何冲击姐姐「底线」？

programme.title: 老友记 / Christian's Choice Episode 7

programme.title: 旅行最紧要近 / Not Far From Here Episode 9
programme.desc:
第9集 岭南园区文化美食游、大师级美术馆建筑 想打卡兼感受岭南文化，必往顺德的园林景区。三主持观赏皮影戏，并体验制作木版年画、鱼灯，敏芝作品却被指太Hea？
行到攰还可移步园林餐厅，将当地怀旧、创新菜一网打尽，某汤品更有「亚洲第一汤」美誉！
深入建筑大师设计的美术馆，见识清水混凝土搭几何形状的建筑美学，藉不同艺术家展品滋养文化气息。
藏于民居的隐世餐厅，由酒店前总厨主理创意顺德菜。生鱼片即席淋热汤浸熟，嫩滑可口；农夫吃鱼头美馔，竟尝出恋爱、人生观？

programme.title: 阿妈唔信我去亚马逊 / I Will Be Back Episode 10
programme.desc: 洪永城身为旅游达人，要去的地方当然不简单，一于勇闯南美洲的亚马逊森林！不同的亚马逊狂人带同永城、胡美贻、布乐文，看尽亚马逊的真面目。到访百万追踪者的网红一家，体验现代土著的Wi-Fi生活；随巴西军人学习野外求生技能；探究一下义工消防员不怕死自发上山救火保护森林的背后原因。同时反转大众印象，去亚马逊睇楼、剪发、学跳舞、变魔术以至搞艺术，发掘一趟令人难以置信的亚马逊旅程。

programme.title: Hands Up / Hands Up 2026 Episode 7
programme.desc:
全新儿童节目《Hands Up》鼓励小朋友勇于发问，表达自我，向目标进发！
吉祥物「酱汁家族」成员跟一众主持演出短剧，陪伴大家度过愉快时光。另会带来多首儿歌，让孩子们边唱边学习生活知识。
小朋友走进录像厂，寓学习于娱乐。透过不同主题游戏，加强逻辑思维、锻练体能；玩转STEAM实验，脑力全开！
节目特设表演小舞台，让小朋友展示才艺；齐集创意工作室，DIY小手工。小教「煮」环节，家长和子女共享亲子烹饪乐趣。

programme.title: 白色强人II / Big White Duel II Episode 17
programme.desc: 第17集 肺病少女罗笑娴命危，文信、霭宁想为少女穿刺引流，湛琛却担心此举会影响尸肺捐赠排名……叶晴获郭昭答应所求，逸滔拜托霭宁和文信游说罕见病病人出席记招，叶晴欲透过铭章的力量阻碍病人出席记招。笑娴的病情日益恶化，唐明尽最后努力劝说其大哥捐肺。一场突如其来的车祸，笑娴的大哥脑出血，宣告脑干死亡，大嫂终答应捐出丈夫的尸肺救助妹妹。逸滔找上叶晴希望合力认可唐明进行肺部移植；心胸肺科医生何秉光却一口拒绝手术……

programme.title: 白色强人II / Big White Duel II Episode 18
programme.desc: 第18集 唐明等人正进行笑娴的肺部移植手术；逸滔早作最坏打算，叶晴想到请来某人帮忙。铭章从升降机中步出，扬言追究到底……少男区子颖经历两次中风，霭宁和苏怡怀疑他吸食毒品，细问下知道另有原因。张庭与逸滔的争论，由逸滔的草案记者会到网上舆论战，各不相让。入夜，笑娴情况急剧恶化……霭宁从文信口中得知叶晴的草案，源自离世男友的论文，终明白叶晴所做一切的动机。有人在餐厅不支倒地，霭宁和文信上前检查，发现竟是子颖。

programme.title: 新闻掏宝 / News Treasury 2025 Episode 3
programme.desc: 常言道：「今日新闻，明日历史」。每天那么多新闻，大家可能来不及消化，更遑论回望历史。历史就是一个大宝库，少看历史和小看历史，很容易「走宝」。新节目《新闻掏宝》带大家在宝库「掏」新闻宝藏，除了昔日特辑、直播和系列报导，还有从未曝光的珍贵片段，观众有机会重温李小龙出殡、宝生银行劫案、四人帮审讯、英女王访港、的士罢驶、中英签订联合声明、戴卓尔夫人专访、越南难民、尤德逝世、彭定康抵港、启德机场关闭、邓小平逝世、九七回归大典、华航香港空难和沙士记者会。

programme.title: 流行经典50年 / Cantopop At 50 Episode 98
programme.desc: 中外乐坛历年来诞生无数金曲，不论甚么年代的作品，皆各有知音人。《流行经典50年》邀请原唱人或实力歌手，再次演绎这些流行一时，兼且跨越多代的经典，为乐迷带来高质素的音乐享受。除了具份量的乐坛前辈之外，不少久未露面的歌手亦应邀在节目现身，献给观众多重惊喜。

programme.title: 美食新闻报道 / Gourmet Express Episode 118
programme.desc: 香港汇聚环球美食，特色佳肴、贴地料理受到识饮识食之人的密切关注！黄婉曼、蔡雪莹、倪嘉雯、黄嘉雯、廖慧仪、伍倩彤等美食主播、主持，紧贴最新饮食情报与优惠，深入了解滋味背后的故事。从不同平台网罗超人气食店的情报，主持亲自出动排队、试食，带来真实食评。不设堂食的外卖小店亦深受追捧，有何必吃之选？经营食店难免尝尽甜酸苦辣，摄制队追踪主理人忙碌的一天，从搜购食材、准备材料到开档做生意，揭开「故事味缘」。

programme.desc: 《中年好声音4》宣布启航，延续前三季的成功，再次为歌唱爱好者筑建逐梦舞台。本季更将招募版图扩展至北美、澳洲等地，还有TVB多位艺员「蒙面」出战，让音乐之火燃遍全球，照亮无数追梦者的心弦。车婉婉继续主持大局，以温暖笑容陪伴一众选手；肥妈、周国丰、张佳添、海儿、谷娅溦亦坐镇评审席，为参赛者提供专业点评与鼓励。在新一季的舞台上，大家将以音乐交织出更动人的篇章，续写属于《中年好声音》的真摰故事。

programme.title: 华润集团呈献:无穷之路V-智行无疆 / China Resources (Holdings) Co. Ltd. Presents: No Poverty Land V - Odyssey of Intelligence Episode 7

programme.title: 最强生命线 / Vital Lifeline Episode 272
programme.desc: 都市人生活节奏紧张，压力又大，身体易出毛病，《最强生命线》为你解构健康之道。首先一连四集介绍都市痛症系列，分别是头痛，肩颈痛，背痛，关节痛。每集都会邀请医学专家讲解各种疾病的成因，还有物理治疗师，运动治疗师教做适当的运动。现在流行中西医结合，美国游泳健将菲比斯都用拔罐来纾缓疼痛，所以每集都会有中医断症，辅以针灸，拔罐和三伏天最适合做的天灸等治疗方法，另外，中医还教我们煲滋补的汤水，都可以调理身体。

programme.title: 新闻掏宝 / News Treasury 2025 Episode 3

programme.title: Hands Up / Hands Up 2026 Episode 8
programme.desc:
全新儿童节目《Hands Up》鼓励小朋友勇于发问，表达自我，向目标进发！
吉祥物「酱汁家族」成员跟一众主持演出短剧，陪伴大家度过愉快时光。另会带来多首儿歌，让孩子们边唱边学习生活知识。
小朋友走进录像厂，寓学习于娱乐。透过不同主题游戏，加强逻辑思维、锻练体能；玩转STEAM实验，脑力全开！

programme.title: 寻欢作乐的姐姐 & 今日知多D / Sis and the Tempting Cities & What's On Today Episode 10
programme.desc: 随着女性经济力量攀升，针对女性群的吃喝玩乐体验应运而生。麦玲玲先与何依婷、林凯恩、何沛珈、刘晓昆结伴同游上海，再会合吴若希、戴祖仪、游嘉欣玩转深圳、广州，以女性角度带大家「寻欢作乐」，见识时下备受姊妹们追捧的潮流文化与玩意，探索网红打卡美食和景点，迎接多个「第一次」！「姐姐们」组团北上尝鲜，猛男烤肉、帅哥居酒屋、小鲜肉按摩店、硬核健身、一对一辣身舞、格斗酒吧等非凡体验，如何冲击姐姐「底线」？

programme.title: 守诚者 / Homeland Guardian Episode 24
programme.desc: 第24集 全港警民全力守城 何浩辉带警员去找周雄，路上给邵峰打电话汇报情况。全球金融峰会现场的刘先生得知炸弹之事，告诉阮sir港府绝无可能向周雄妥协，阮sir表示已经安排警力，守备在会场的部分警力也调动过去，刘先生指示一定要在股市开市前拆除炸弹。陈耀扬让骆雅琪一定要在股市开市前抓到安娜，阻止他们的计划。 蔡卓欣被周雄手下带到了假三号车上。骆雅琪等警员通过断电的手段确定了安娜及其手下所在的房间，周雄和安娜通电话，两人信心满满在股市开市时启动金融核弹。此时正在放假的棠哥，在街上看到了假三号车，急忙打的士尾随这辆假三号车，给梁婉婷打电话知道三号车并没有修好。何浩辉得知周雄到了历新大厦，迅速驱车赶往，此时的周雄正在大厦的天台上远眺会展中心。假三号车进了会展中心地下车库，棠哥所坐的士被值守的警员截停，他无法进入地下车库，给梁婉婷打电话求助，梁婉婷和谢庭威带棠哥进入地下车库。
